title.zh-CN: 右侧无力伴言语困难 · 67岁男性
title.en: Right-sided weakness and difficulty speaking · 67-year-old man

summary.zh-CN: 67岁男性，由120救护车送入急诊抢救室，妻子陪同：右侧手脚突然没劲、说不出话。时间敏感的急诊模拟——在分秒必争中完成评估、判读、安全决策与处置，并与家属沟通。
summary.en: A 67-year-old man is brought to the resus room by ambulance with his wife: his right arm and leg have suddenly gone weak and he cannot get his words out. A time-critical emergency simulation — assess, interpret, decide safely and treat against the clock, while keeping his wife informed.

notes.zh-CN: 完全虚构的教学病例，依据现行AHA/ASA、ESO/ESMINT及中华医学会神经病学分会指南编写；姓名均为化名，不对应任何真实患者。所有数值为教学设计并经内部一致性核对（见README与extensions.clinicalScores）。
notes.en: Entirely fictional teaching case written to current AHA/ASA, ESO/ESMINT and Chinese Society of Neurology guidance; all names are pseudonyms and correspond to no real patient. Every number was designed for teaching and cross-checked for internal consistency (see README and extensions.clinicalScores).

disclaimer.zh-CN: 虚构教学病例，不构成医疗建议。
disclaimer.en: Fictional teaching case — not medical advice.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 右侧肢体无力、说话困难约1小时
chiefComplaint.en: Right-sided weakness and difficulty speaking for about an hour

triageNote.zh-CN: 67岁男性，10:05由120救护车送入急诊，妻子陪同。急救人员途中已电话预警：约09:10妻子发现其右侧手脚无力、几乎不能说话。分诊：BP 192/104 mmHg（MAP 133 mmHg），HR 96次/分、脉律不齐，RR 18次/分，SpO₂ 96%（未吸氧），T 36.8 ℃。清醒，能按指令睁闭眼，几乎说不出话。院前血糖仪故障未测血糖，未建立静脉通路，未用任何药物。已安置于抢救室1床，尚未连接监护。
triageNote.en: 67-year-old man brought in by 120 ambulance at 10:05 with his wife. The crew phoned ahead: at about 09:10 his wife found him with right-sided weakness and barely able to speak. Triage: BP 192/104 mmHg (MAP 133 mmHg), HR 96/min and irregular, RR 18/min, SpO₂ 96% on room air, T 36.8 °C. Awake, opens and closes his eyes to command, almost no speech. No pre-hospital glucose (the glucometer failed), no IV access, no medicines given. Placed in resus bay 1; not yet on the monitor.

personality.zh-CN: 退休电工，平时爱说爱笑、要强；此刻清醒、听得懂，却说不出话，非常着急、害怕，常因表达不出而沮丧地摇头。
personality.en: A retired electrician, normally chatty, good-humoured and independent; now alert and understanding but unable to get words out — frightened, and shakes his head in frustration when he cannot express himself.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 非流利型（运动性）失语：说话费力、断断续续，每次只能挤出一两个词（“我……不……”“对、对”），常卡住说不下去；能听懂简单问题，用点头、摇头和左手手势回答是/否。病史主要由妻子回答，妻子说话条理清楚、语速偏快。
speechStyle.en: Non-fluent (expressive) aphasia: effortful, halting speech of one or two words at a time ("I… no…", "yes, yes"), often getting stuck; understands simple questions and answers yes/no by nodding, shaking his head or gesturing with his left hand. His wife gives the history — clear and organised, if a little fast.

openingLine.zh-CN: （患者看着你，张了张嘴）“我……我……嗯……”（沮丧地摇头，用左手指指嘴巴）妻子：“医生，他突然说不出话了，右边胳膊和腿也没劲儿！”
openingLine.en: (He looks at you and opens his mouth) "I… I… mm…" (shakes his head in frustration and points at his mouth with his left hand) His wife: "Doctor, he suddenly can't talk, and his right arm and leg have gone weak!"

fallbackUnknown.en: (Wife) I'm not sure about that, doctor.

concerns.zh-CN: （妻子）是不是中风了？他会不会像他爸那样瘫在床上？
concerns.en: (Wife) Is it a stroke? Will he end up bedridden like his father?

concerns.zh-CN: （妻子）打那种溶血栓的针，会不会脑子出血？
concerns.en: (Wife) That clot-busting injection — couldn't it make his brain bleed?

concerns.zh-CN: （妻子）他最怕拖累家里……还能恢复说话吗？
concerns.en: (Wife) He dreads being a burden on the family… will he be able to talk again?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 患者：清醒，眼睛和头偏向左侧，右侧口角下垂、轻微流涎，右上肢软瘫在床上；能听懂并执行简单指令（睁眼闭眼、左手握拳松开），对是/否问题点头或摇头；试图说话时只能挤出零碎词语，说不出来时沮丧、眼眶发红。不自己讲述病史。若病情恶化（剧烈头痛、呕吐、昏睡）则表现为抱头、呻吟、呼之难醒；若血压骤降则更加嗜睡、右侧完全不动。取栓再通后能说简短的句子（“好……好多了”），右手能抬起一点。妻子：65岁，焦虑但条理清楚，负责回答病史；只回答被问到的内容，不主动补充；不会使用医学术语，也不会自行推测诊断或检查结果。
actingNotes.en: Patient: alert; eyes and head turned to the left; right corner of the mouth droops with slight drooling; right arm lies limp on the trolley. Understands and follows simple commands (eyes open/close, grip/release with the left hand); nods or shakes his head to yes/no questions; when he tries to speak only fragments come out and he becomes frustrated and teary. Does not give the history himself. If he deteriorates (severe headache, vomiting, drowsiness) he clutches his head, groans and is hard to rouse; if his blood pressure crashes he becomes drowsier and the right side stops moving altogether. After successful thrombectomy he manages short phrases ("bet… better") and can lift his right hand a little. Wife: 65, anxious but organised; she gives the history, answers only what she is asked without volunteering extra detail, uses no medical jargon and never guesses at diagnoses or results.

persona.zh-CN: 65岁，退休小学教师，心思细，每周亲手给丈夫分药盒，对他的用药和作息很清楚；焦虑但配合，回答病史准确，能代表家属签署知情同意书；最怕丈夫像公公一样卧床不起。
persona.en: 65, a retired primary-school teacher; meticulous — she fills his weekly pill box herself and knows his medicines and routine precisely. Anxious but cooperative, gives an accurate history and can sign consent for the family; her greatest fear is that he will end up bedridden like his father.

description.zh-CN: 到院后的评估、影像与静脉溶栓。
description.en: Assessment, imaging and intravenous thrombolysis after arrival.

description.zh-CN: 转入导管室后的脑血管造影与机械取栓。
description.en: Cerebral angiography and mechanical thrombectomy after transfer.

question.zh-CN: 他今天出了什么事？
question.en: What happened to him today?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）他突然说不出话了，右边胳膊和腿也没劲儿。我在阳台晾衣服，听见客厅“啪”的一声，跑进去一看，他歪在沙发上，茶杯摔在地上，右手耷拉着，嘴也歪了。他想跟我说话，可只会“嗯……啊……”。我马上就打了120。
answer.en: (Wife) He suddenly couldn't get his words out, and his right arm and leg went weak. I was hanging the washing on the balcony when I heard a crash in the living room — he was slumped sideways on the sofa with his tea cup smashed on the floor, his right hand hanging limp and his mouth drooping. He was trying to talk to me but all that came out was "mm… ah…". I called 120 straight away.

question.zh-CN: 最后一次确认他完全正常是几点？
question.en: When was he last seen completely normal?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）八点五十五左右。吃完早饭他坐在沙发上看报纸，八点五十五我去阳台晾衣服前还跟他说话，他说九点半下楼遛弯，说话一点问题都没有，手也好好地拿着报纸。我在阳台待了十几分钟，九点十分左右听见茶杯摔了，进去他就成这样了。所以到底几点开始的我也说不准，就在这中间。
answer.en: (Wife) About five to nine. After breakfast he was on the sofa reading the paper. At 8:55, just before I went out to hang the washing, I was chatting with him — he said he'd go down for his walk at half past nine. He spoke perfectly normally and was holding the paper fine. I was on the balcony for about a quarter of an hour, and at around ten past nine I heard the cup smash and found him like this. So I can't say exactly when it started — somewhere in between.

question.zh-CN: 有没有人亲眼看到他发病的那一刻？
question.en: Did anyone actually see the moment it started?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）没有。家里就我们俩，我当时在阳台。我进去的时候他已经是这样了。
answer.en: (Wife) No. It's just the two of us at home and I was out on the balcony. By the time I got to him he was already like this.

question.zh-CN: 发现以后症状是一直这样，还是有好转或加重？
question.en: Since you found him, have the symptoms stayed the same, got better or got worse?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）一直这样，一点都没见好，也没觉得更重。在救护车上也是这样。
answer.en: (Wife) Just the same the whole time — no better at all, and I don't think any worse. It was the same in the ambulance.

question.zh-CN: 他有没有摔倒、撞到头，或者最近受过外伤？
question.en: Did he fall or hit his head, or has he had any recent injury?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）没有摔到地上，他是歪在沙发扶手上的，头没磕着。最近也没摔过跤、没受过伤。
answer.en: (Wife) He didn't fall to the floor — he slumped against the arm of the sofa and didn't bang his head. He hasn't had any falls or injuries lately either.

question.zh-CN: 他有没有头痛、恶心或者呕吐？
question.en: Has he had any headache, nausea or vomiting?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）没吐。我问他头疼不疼，他摇头。也没见他捂着头。
answer.en: (Wife) He hasn't vomited. I asked him if his head hurt and he shook his head. He hasn't been holding his head either.

question.zh-CN: 有没有昏过去、抽搐、咬舌头或者尿裤子？以前有过癫痫吗？
question.en: Did he black out or have any shaking, tongue-biting or incontinence? Any history of epilepsy?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）没有。我进去的时候他睁着眼看我，没抽，也没尿裤子。他从来没有过癫痫（羊癫疯）。
answer.en: (Wife) No. When I came in his eyes were open and he was looking at me. No shaking, no wetting himself. He's never had epilepsy or fits.

question.zh-CN: 他有没有胸痛或者背痛？
question.en: Has he had any chest or back pain?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）没听他说过。今天早上好好的，没捂胸口，也没说背疼。
answer.en: (Wife) Not that he's said. He was fine this morning — he wasn't holding his chest or complaining about his back.

question.zh-CN: 最近有没有心慌、心跳快或心里扑腾的感觉？
question.en: Has he had palpitations — a racing or fluttering heart — recently?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）这个月说过两三回心里“扑腾扑腾”的，过一会儿就好了，他也没当回事。
answer.en: (Wife) A couple of times this month he said his heart was "fluttering", but it settled after a while and he didn't make anything of it.

question.zh-CN: 以前有没有过类似的短暂发作——比如一侧手脚发麻、无力或说话不清，后来自己好了？
question.en: Has he ever had a brief episode like this before — numbness, weakness or trouble speaking that got better on its own?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）您这么一问我想起来了……大概三个星期前吃晚饭时，他右手突然发麻、拿不住筷子，十来分钟就好了。他说就是“手麻了一下”，没去看病。
answer.en: (Wife) Now that you ask… about three weeks ago at dinner his right hand suddenly went numb and he couldn't hold his chopsticks. It passed in about ten minutes. He said it was "just pins and needles" and wouldn't see a doctor.

question.zh-CN: 他父亲当年是脑梗死还是脑出血？
question.en: Was his father's stroke a clot or a bleed?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）这个我真不知道，只知道是中风。
answer.en: (Wife) I really don't know — only that it was a stroke.

question.zh-CN: 他以前得过中风（脑梗或脑出血）吗？
question.en: Has he ever had a stroke — a clot or a bleed in the brain?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）没有，从来没有医生说过他中风。
answer.en: (Wife) No, no doctor has ever told him he's had a stroke.

question.zh-CN: 他有高血压吗？控制得怎么样？
question.en: Does he have high blood pressure? How well controlled is it?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）有，十来年了，一直吃氨氯地平。在家量一般一百五十多，医生说还得再降一降，可他不愿意多吃药。
answer.en: (Wife) Yes, for about ten years. He takes amlodipine. When we check at home it's usually in the 150s — the doctor said it should be lower, but he doesn't like taking more pills.

question.zh-CN: 他有没有房颤或者其他心律不齐？
question.en: Does he have atrial fibrillation or any other heart-rhythm problem?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）有。两年前他心慌去看心内科，戴了一个24小时的心电图，医生说是“阵发性房颤”，建议吃抗凝药预防中风。
answer.en: (Wife) Yes. Two years ago he had palpitations and saw a cardiologist; he wore a 24-hour heart monitor and they said "paroxysmal atrial fibrillation". The doctor advised a blood thinner to prevent a stroke.

question.zh-CN: 还有其他病吗？比如糖尿病、冠心病心梗、肾病、肝病或者肿瘤？
question.en: Any other illnesses — diabetes, heart attack, kidney or liver disease, cancer?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）没有糖尿病，去年体检说血糖“稍微有点高”，没吃药。没得过心梗，肾、肝都没毛病，也没有肿瘤。
answer.en: (Wife) No diabetes — last year's check-up said his sugar was "a little high", but he's not on anything for it. Never had a heart attack, nothing wrong with his kidneys or liver, no cancer.

question.zh-CN: 他平时吃哪些药？
question.en: What medicines does he take regularly?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）就两样：氨氯地平5毫克，每天早上一片，今天早饭后八点半左右吃过了；还有一片钙片加维生素D。药都是我每周给他分在药盒里的。
answer.en: (Wife) Just two things: amlodipine 5 mg, one every morning — he took it after breakfast at about half past eight today — and a calcium-and-vitamin-D tablet. I sort all his pills into a weekly pill box.

question.zh-CN: 他有没有在吃抗凝药或抗血小板药——比如华法林、利伐沙班、达比加群、阿哌沙班、艾多沙班，或者阿司匹林、氯吡格雷？
question.en: Is he taking any blood thinners — warfarin, rivaroxaban, dabigatran, apixaban, edoxaban — or antiplatelets such as aspirin or clopidogrel?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）没有，一样都没有。查出房颤那次医生建议吃抗凝药，他怕出血，一直没吃。阿司匹林也没吃。药盒是我分的，我敢肯定，就降压药和钙片。
answer.en: (Wife) No, none of them. When they found the AF the doctor recommended a blood thinner, but he was afraid of bleeding and never started it. No aspirin either. I fill his pill box myself, so I'm certain — just the blood-pressure pill and the calcium.

question.zh-CN: 他对什么药物或食物过敏吗？
question.en: Does he have any allergies to medicines or foods?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）没有，没听说对什么药或者吃的东西过敏。
answer.en: (Wife) No — no allergies to any medicines or foods that we know of.

question.zh-CN: 他以前有没有出血的问题——脑出血、胃肠道出血、黑便、尿血，或者出血不容易止住？
question.en: Has he ever had bleeding problems — a brain bleed, stomach or bowel bleeding, black stools, blood in the urine, or bleeding that is hard to stop?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）都没有。没吐过血，大便正常，从来没有黑的，也没尿过血。就是刷牙时牙龈偶尔出一点点血。
answer.en: (Wife) None of that. He's never vomited blood, his stools are normal and never black, no blood in his urine. His gums bleed a tiny bit sometimes when he brushes, that's all.

question.zh-CN: 最近三个月有没有做过手术、拔牙、穿刺或者住过院？
question.en: Any surgery, procedures, dental extractions or hospital admissions in the last three months?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）没有。他这辈子就十五年前做过一次疝气手术。今年没住过院，也没拔过牙。
answer.en: (Wife) No. The only operation he's ever had was a hernia repair fifteen years ago. No hospital stays this year, no teeth pulled.

question.zh-CN: 发病前他的生活自理能力怎么样？
question.en: Before today, how independent was he in daily life?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）完全自理，比我还能干。每天早上下楼走一个小时，自己买菜做饭，周末跟老同事下象棋，走路不用拐杖。
answer.en: (Wife) Completely independent — more active than me. He walks for an hour every morning, does the shopping and cooking himself and plays Chinese chess with his old workmates at weekends. He doesn't use a stick.

question.zh-CN: 他大概多重？
question.en: Roughly how much does he weigh?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）一百六十斤，就是80公斤。上个月社区体检刚称过，80公斤，身高一米七二。
answer.en: (Wife) Eighty kilos — 160 jin. They weighed him at the community health check last month: 80 kg, and he's 1.72 m tall.

question.zh-CN: 他抽烟吗？
question.en: Does he smoke?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）以前抽，一天一包，抽了三十年，十年前戒了，现在一根都不碰。
answer.en: (Wife) He used to — a pack a day for thirty years. He quit ten years ago and hasn't touched one since.

question.zh-CN: 他喝酒吗？
question.en: Does he drink alcohol?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）偶尔，周末跟老同事吃饭喝一两小杯白酒，平时不喝。
answer.en: (Wife) Only now and then — one or two small glasses of baijiu with his old workmates at the weekend. Not otherwise.

question.zh-CN: 他退休前做什么工作？现在和谁一起住？
question.en: What did he do for a living, and who does he live with?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）他是退休电工，退休七年了。就我们老两口住，三楼，有电梯。儿子住得不远，已经在往医院赶了。
answer.en: (Wife) He's a retired electrician — retired seven years ago. It's just the two of us, on the third floor with a lift. Our son lives nearby and he's on his way in.

question.zh-CN: 家里人有中风、心脏病或者其他遗传病吗？
question.en: Any stroke, heart disease or other illnesses in the family?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）他爸七十二岁中风，后来瘫在床上好几年才走的。他妈有高血压，八十多岁去世的。
answer.en: (Wife) His father had a stroke at 72 and was bedridden for several years before he died. His mother had high blood pressure and died in her eighties.

question.zh-CN: 他今天最后一次吃东西、喝水是什么时候？
question.en: When did he last eat or drink anything?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）八点半吃的早饭，一碗白粥、一个馒头，喝了半杯水把药吃了。后来就喝了几口茶。
answer.en: (Wife) Breakfast at half past eight — a bowl of rice porridge and a steamed bun — and half a glass of water to take his pills. Just a few sips of tea after that.

question.zh-CN: 您现在最担心的是什么？
question.en: What are you most worried about right now?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）我就怕他是中风了，像他爸那样瘫在床上……他最怕给家里添麻烦。医生，这还能治好吗？
answer.en: (Wife) I'm terrified it's a stroke and he'll end up bedridden like his father… he'd hate being a burden on the family. Doctor, can this be treated?

question.zh-CN: 如果需要做有一定风险的紧急治疗，他本人会怎么选？
question.en: If an urgent treatment carries some risk, what would he want?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）他肯定愿意治，只要有希望就治。他常说宁可冒点险，也不要像他爸那样拖着。你们该用什么就用，我来签字。
answer.en: (Wife) He'd definitely want it if there's any chance. He always says he'd rather take a risk than linger like his father did. Do whatever you need to — I'll sign.

question.zh-CN: 今天早上在家量过血压吗？
question.en: Did you check his blood pressure at home this morning?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）今天没量，不知道多少。
answer.en: (Wife) We didn't check it today, so I don't know.

question.zh-CN: 他的血脂（胆固醇）高吗？
question.en: Does he have high cholesterol?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）血脂我不清楚，没注意过具体数字。
answer.en: (Wife) I don't know about his cholesterol — I've never looked at the numbers.

question.zh-CN: 他是右撇子还是左撇子？
question.en: Is he right- or left-handed?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）右撇子，写字、拿筷子、干电工活都用右手。
answer.en: (Wife) Right-handed — he writes, uses chopsticks and did all his electrical work with his right hand.

question.zh-CN: 最近有没有发烧、咳嗽、感冒或者其他感染？
question.en: Has he had any fever, cough, cold or other infection recently?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）没有，最近没发过烧，也没咳嗽感冒，身体一直挺好的。
answer.en: (Wife) No — no fever, no cough or cold lately. He's been perfectly well.

question.zh-CN: 他有没有说过看东西模糊、看重影、头晕，或者哪里发麻？
question.en: Has he mentioned blurred or double vision, dizziness, or numbness anywhere?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）他说不出话，这些我都不知道——看东西清不清楚、头晕不晕、哪里麻，他没法告诉我。
answer.en: (Wife) He can't get the words out, so I don't know — whether his sight is blurred, whether he's dizzy or numb anywhere, he hasn't been able to tell me.

question.zh-CN: 他有没有用过毒品或者其他违禁药物？
question.en: Does he use any recreational or illicit drugs?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）没有，从来不碰那些东西。
answer.en: (Wife) No, never — he's never touched anything like that.

question.zh-CN: 发病以后他吃过、喝过东西吗？咽东西有没有呛？
question.en: Has he had anything to eat or drink since this started — any choking or coughing when swallowing?

answer.zh-CN: （妻子）出事以后什么都没吃没喝，我没敢给他喝水，救护车上也没给。就是右边嘴角一直有点流口水。
answer.en: (Wife) Nothing at all since it happened — I didn't dare give him anything to drink, and the ambulance crew didn't either. He's been dribbling a bit from the right corner of his mouth.

maneuver.zh-CN: 观察一般情况

finding.zh-CN: 平卧于抢救床，清醒，眼睛睁开，表情焦急、沮丧。头和双眼偏向左侧。右侧口角下垂，右嘴角少量流涎。右上肢软软地搭在床上不动，左手不时比划。试图说话时只能断断续续挤出一两个字。无发绀，呼吸平稳。
finding.en: Lying on the trolley, awake with eyes open, looking anxious and frustrated. Head and eyes turned to the left. The right corner of his mouth droops with a little drooling. His right arm lies limp and motionless on the trolley while he gestures with his left hand. When he tries to speak only one or two broken words come out. Not cyanosed; breathing comfortably.

maneuver.zh-CN: 评估气道与呼吸（能否保护气道）

finding.zh-CN: 气道通畅，能自行处理口腔分泌物（仅右口角少量流涎），无喘鸣或痰鸣音；呼吸平稳，双侧胸廓起伏对称。
finding.en: Airway patent; he manages his own secretions apart from slight drooling from the right corner of the mouth; no stridor or gurgling. Breathing comfortably with equal chest expansion.

maneuver.zh-CN: 格拉斯哥昏迷评分（GCS）

finding.zh-CN: GCS 13分（E4 V3 M6）：自动睁眼，能遵嘱活动；言语评分偏低是因为失语（只能说零碎词语），而非意识水平下降——他是清醒的。建议记录为“V-失语”。
finding.en: GCS 13 (E4 V3 M6): eyes open spontaneously and he obeys commands; the low verbal score reflects aphasia (only fragmentary words), not reduced consciousness — he is alert. Best recorded as "V – aphasic".

maneuver.zh-CN: NIH卒中量表（NIHSS）评分

en: national institutes of health stroke scale

finding.zh-CN: NIHSS 14分：1a意识水平0（清醒）；1b意识水平提问1（费力说出年龄“六十七”，说不出现在的月份）；1c意识水平指令0（睁闭眼、左手握拳松开均正确）；2凝视1（部分凝视麻痹：双眼偏向左侧，头眼反射可越过中线）；3视野1（部分偏盲：右下象限）；4面瘫2（右侧下面部部分瘫痪）；5a左上肢0；5b右上肢3（不能抗重力，立即落床，床面上可轻微移动）；6a左下肢0；6b右下肢2（能部分抗重力，5秒内落床）；7共济失调0（左侧正常，右侧因瘫痪无法完成，按0分）；8感觉1（右侧面部、上下肢针刺觉轻中度减退）；9语言2（严重失语：表达呈碎片化、极费力，图片描述基本无法辨认内容；简单指令理解保留）；10构音障碍1（能说出的词轻中度含糊）；11忽视0。合计14分。
finding.en: NIHSS 14: 1a LOC 0 (alert); 1b LOC questions 1 (with effort gives his age, "sixty-seven", but cannot name the month); 1c LOC commands 0 (eye opening/closing and left-hand grip/release both correct); 2 gaze 1 (partial gaze palsy — eyes deviated to the left, overcome by the oculocephalic manoeuvre); 3 visual fields 1 (partial hemianopia — right lower quadrant); 4 facial palsy 2 (partial paralysis of the right lower face); 5a left arm 0; 5b right arm 3 (no effort against gravity — falls straight to the bed, slight movement on the bed); 6a left leg 0; 6b right leg 2 (some effort against gravity, falls to the bed within 5 s); 7 limb ataxia 0 (left normal; right untestable because of weakness, scored 0); 8 sensory 1 (mild–moderate loss to pinprick on the right face, arm and leg); 9 language 2 (severe aphasia — fragmentary, very effortful output; the picture description is almost entirely unidentifiable; comprehension of simple commands preserved); 10 dysarthria 1 (mild–moderate slurring of the words he manages); 11 extinction/inattention 0. Total 14.

maneuver.zh-CN: 评估言语与语言（流利度、命名、复述、理解）
maneuver.en: Assess speech and language (fluency, naming, repetition, comprehension)

finding.zh-CN: 非流利性失语：自发言语极少、费力，以单字或两三个字的碎片为主，伴明显找词停顿；不能命名钢笔和手表；不能复述短句；能正确执行一步和两步指令（“闭上眼睛，然后握我的手”），对是/否问题点头摇头可靠。说出的词轻中度含糊。符合左侧额叶（Broca区）受累为主的运动性失语。
finding.en: Non-fluent aphasia: very little, effortful spontaneous speech — single words or two- to three-word fragments with obvious word-finding pauses; cannot name a pen or a watch; cannot repeat a short phrase; follows one- and two-step commands correctly ("close your eyes, then squeeze my hand") and answers yes/no reliably by nodding or shaking his head. The words he manages are mildly to moderately slurred. An expressive (Broca-type) aphasia, pointing to the left frontal operculum.

maneuver.zh-CN: 检查瞳孔与眼球运动（凝视）

finding.zh-CN: 双侧瞳孔等大等圆，直径3 mm，对光反射灵敏。双眼静息时偏向左侧，嘱其向右看只能勉强回到中线；头眼反射（玩偶眼）可使双眼充分向右运动——部分性凝视麻痹，左侧凝视偏好（看向病灶侧）。无眼震。
finding.en: Pupils equal and round, 3 mm, briskly reactive to light. At rest both eyes deviate to the left; asked to look right he can only just reach the midline, but the oculocephalic (doll's-eye) manoeuvre drives both eyes fully to the right — a partial gaze palsy with left gaze preference (looking towards the lesion). No nystagmus.

maneuver.zh-CN: 对诊法检查视野

finding.zh-CN: 对诊法（数手指/威胁反射）：双眼均反复漏掉右下象限的刺激，其余象限正常——右侧同向性部分偏盲（右下象限盲）。
finding.en: Confrontation (finger counting and threat): with each eye he repeatedly misses stimuli in the right lower quadrant; the other quadrants are intact — a partial right homonymous field defect (right inferior quadrantanopia).

maneuver.zh-CN: 检查面部运动（示齿、皱额、闭眼）
maneuver.en: Facial movements (smile, raise eyebrows, close eyes)

finding.zh-CN: 右侧下面部接近完全瘫痪：右侧鼻唇沟消失，示齿和微笑时右侧口角几乎不动、嘴被拉向左侧，右口角流涎；皱额和闭眼两侧对称有力——右侧中枢性（上运动神经元型）面瘫，额肌不受累（NIHSS第4项2分）。
finding.en: Near-total paralysis of the right lower face: the right nasolabial fold is effaced, the right corner of the mouth barely moves when he smiles or shows his teeth so the mouth is pulled to the left, and he drools from the right. Forehead wrinkling and eye closure are symmetrical and strong — a right upper-motor-neurone (central) facial palsy with forehead sparing (NIHSS item 4 = 2).

maneuver.zh-CN: 上肢肌力与平举试验（旋前漂移）

finding.zh-CN: 仰卧位双上肢抬至45°：左上肢保持10秒无下落；右上肢不能抗重力抬起，立即落床，仅能在床面上轻微滑动。右侧握力很弱（MRC约1–2级），左侧肌力5级。
finding.en: Supine, arms raised to 45°: the left arm holds for 10 s without drift; the right arm cannot be lifted against gravity and falls to the bed at once, managing only a slight slide across the sheet. Right grip very weak (about MRC 1–2/5); left side 5/5.

maneuver.zh-CN: 下肢肌力（抬腿试验）

finding.zh-CN: 仰卧位双下肢抬至30°：左下肢保持5秒；右下肢能勉强抬离床面，但约3秒内落回床上（部分抗重力）。右髋屈约3-级，左下肢5级。
finding.en: Supine, legs raised to 30°: the left leg holds for 5 s; the right leg lifts off the bed with effort but drops back within about 3 s (some effort against gravity). Right hip flexion about 3−/5; left leg 5/5.

maneuver.zh-CN: 肌张力、腱反射与病理征

finding.zh-CN: 右侧上下肢肌张力减低（超急性期软瘫）。肱二头肌、肱三头肌、膝、踝反射双侧均可引出、基本对称。右侧巴宾斯基征阳性，左侧跖反射屈性。
finding.en: Reduced tone in the right arm and leg (hyperacute flaccidity). Biceps, triceps, knee and ankle jerks present and roughly symmetrical. Right plantar extensor (Babinski positive); left plantar flexor.

maneuver.zh-CN: 感觉检查（针刺觉）

finding.zh-CN: 与左侧相比，右侧面部、上肢和下肢针刺觉减退（他用点头示意“右边钝一些”），但仍能感知被触碰。
finding.en: Compared with the left, pinprick feels duller on the right face, arm and leg (he indicates "duller on the right" by nodding), though he still knows he is being touched.

maneuver.zh-CN: 共济运动（指鼻、跟膝胫试验）

finding.zh-CN: 左侧指鼻和跟膝胫试验准确；右侧因肌力差无法完成（NIHSS第7项按0分计）。
finding.en: Finger–nose and heel–shin accurate on the left; cannot be tested on the right because of weakness (scored 0 on NIHSS item 7).

maneuver.zh-CN: 忽视与感觉消退（双侧同时刺激）

finding.zh-CN: 双侧同时触碰双手均能指出两侧；视觉双侧同时刺激也能识别；能注意到左右两侧空间——无忽视或消退。
finding.en: With bilateral simultaneous touch he points to both hands, and he identifies bilateral simultaneous visual stimuli; he attends to both sides of space — no neglect or extinction.

maneuver.zh-CN: 检查头面部外伤、舌咬伤及皮肤出血点
maneuver.en: Inspect for head injury, tongue bite and bleeding signs

finding.zh-CN: 头皮无血肿、裂伤或压痛；无舌咬伤；无尿失禁；皮肤黏膜无瘀点、紫癜或瘀斑，无近期穿刺痕迹。
finding.en: No scalp haematoma, laceration or tenderness; no tongue bite; not incontinent; no petechiae, purpura or bruising, and no recent puncture marks.

maneuver.zh-CN: 颈部检查及颈动脉听诊

finding.zh-CN: 颈软，无脑膜刺激征；双侧颈动脉未闻及血管杂音。
finding.en: Neck supple, no meningism; no carotid bruits on either side.

maneuver.zh-CN: 脉搏与心脏检查

finding.zh-CN: 桡动脉脉律绝对不齐，约90次/分；心尖部听诊心律绝对不齐、心音强弱不等，心尖心率约96次/分，略快于桡动脉脉率（轻度脉搏短绌）；未闻及杂音。四肢外周动脉搏动可及。
finding.en: Irregularly irregular radial pulse, about 90/min; at the apex the rhythm is irregularly irregular with heart sounds of varying intensity and the apical rate (about 96/min) slightly exceeds the radial rate (small pulse deficit); no murmurs. Peripheral pulses present in all four limbs.

maneuver.zh-CN: 测量双上肢血压

finding.zh-CN: 左上肢 192/104 mmHg，右上肢 188/102 mmHg，两侧收缩压差4 mmHg（< 20 mmHg）。
finding.en: Left arm 192/104 mmHg, right arm 188/102 mmHg — a 4 mmHg systolic difference (< 20 mmHg).

maneuver.zh-CN: 肺部听诊

finding.zh-CN: 双肺呼吸音清，未闻及干湿啰音。
finding.en: Clear breath sounds throughout both lungs; no crackles or wheeze.

maneuver.zh-CN: 眼底检查

finding.zh-CN: 双侧视盘边界清楚，无视乳头水肿；视网膜动脉变细，可见动静脉交叉压迹（高血压视网膜病变II级）；未见出血或渗出。
finding.en: Both optic discs sharp with no papilloedema; arteriolar narrowing and arteriovenous nicking (grade II hypertensive retinopathy); no haemorrhages or exudates.

examNotRecorded.zh-CN: 本病例未记录该项检查结果。
examNotRecorded.en: This examination is not recorded for this case.

text.zh-CN: 指尖血糖 7.2 mmol/L（约130 mg/dL）。排除低血糖（及严重高血糖）所致的类卒中表现；血糖不构成溶栓禁忌（< 2.8 mmol/L或 > 22.2 mmol/L时需先纠正再评估）。
text.en: Capillary glucose 7.2 mmol/L (≈ 130 mg/dL). Excludes hypoglycaemia (and severe hyperglycaemia) as a stroke mimic; glucose does not bar thrombolysis (correct and reassess if < 2.8 mmol/L [50 mg/dL] or > 22.2 mmol/L [400 mg/dL]).

text.zh-CN: 头颅CT平扫（卒中通道急诊读片）：未见颅内出血。左侧大脑中动脉M1段呈高密度（“大脑中动脉高密度征”）。左侧岛叶皮层灰白质分界稍模糊（“岛带征”），左侧尾状核、豆状核、内囊及M1–M6皮层区密度正常——ASPECTS 9分（岛叶1区受累）。无已确立的低密度梗死灶，无占位效应及中线移位。双侧脑室旁少许斑片状低密度（小血管病，Fazekas 1级）。未见陈旧梗死灶。脑室、脑沟与年龄相符。无颅骨骨折。
text.en: Non-contrast CT head (stroke-pathway hot report): no intracranial haemorrhage. Hyperdense left middle cerebral artery M1 segment ("hyperdense MCA sign"). Subtle loss of grey–white differentiation in the left insular cortex ("insular ribbon sign"); left caudate, lentiform, internal capsule and M1–M6 cortical regions normal — ASPECTS 9 (insula only). No established hypodensity, no mass effect or midline shift. Mild periventricular white-matter hypodensity (small-vessel disease, Fazekas 1). No old infarcts. Ventricles and sulci appropriate for age. No skull fracture.

refText.zh-CN: 10 = 正常；≥ 6 有利于血管内治疗

note.zh-CN: ASPECTS从10分起，每个受累区域（C、L、IC、I、M1–M6）减1分。
note.en: ASPECTS starts at 10 and subtracts 1 for each affected region (C, L, IC, I, M1–M6).

name.en: CT angiography of head and neck (CTA)

text.zh-CN: 头颈CTA（紧接平扫完成，碘对比剂60 mL）：左侧大脑中动脉M1段近端截断性闭塞，起自颈内动脉末端以远约8 mm，闭塞段长约12 mm；远端M2分支经软脑膜侧支逆向显影，侧支循环中等偏好（Tan评分2/3，> 50%）。左侧颈内动脉全程通畅，无串联闭塞或夹层。双侧颈动脉分叉处少许钙化斑块，狭窄 < 50%（NASCET）。椎-基底动脉系统通畅。未见动脉瘤。
text.en: CTA head and neck (acquired straight after the plain scan, 60 mL iodinated contrast): abrupt occlusion of the proximal left MCA M1 segment, starting about 8 mm beyond the ICA terminus, occluded length about 12 mm; distal M2 branches fill retrogradely via leptomeningeal collaterals — moderate-to-good collaterals (Tan score 2/3, > 50%). Left ICA patent throughout, with no tandem occlusion or dissection. Minor calcified plaque at both carotid bifurcations, < 50% stenosis (NASCET). Vertebrobasilar system patent. No aneurysm.

note.zh-CN: 无已知肾病的疑似大血管闭塞患者，不应为等待肌酐结果而推迟CTA。
note.en: In suspected large-vessel occlusion without known renal disease, CTA should not wait for a creatinine result.

text.zh-CN: CT灌注（自动后处理）：缺血核心（rCBF < 30%）12 mL；低灌注区（Tmax > 6 s）128 mL；错配体积116 mL，错配比10.7。位于左侧大脑中动脉供血区。
text.en: CT perfusion (automated post-processing): ischaemic core (rCBF < 30%) 12 mL; hypoperfused tissue (Tmax > 6 s) 128 mL; mismatch volume 116 mL, mismatch ratio 10.7 — in the left MCA territory.

note.zh-CN: 距最后正常时间 < 4.5小时的静脉溶栓和 < 6小时的取栓决策不需要灌注成像；额外扫描和后处理会延误再灌注。
note.en: Perfusion imaging is not needed for thrombolysis within 4.5 h or thrombectomy within 6 h of last known well; the extra acquisition and processing delay reperfusion.

text.zh-CN: 心房颤动，平均心室率约96次/分（82–114次/分），电轴正常，QRS 90 ms，QTc 440 ms。左心室高电压（SV1 + RV5 = 4.2 mV），无劳损型ST-T改变。无急性ST段抬高或压低。
text.en: Atrial fibrillation, mean ventricular rate about 96/min (82–114/min), normal axis, QRS 90 ms, QTc 440 ms. Left ventricular voltage criteria (SV1 + RV5 = 4.2 mV) without strain pattern. No acute ST elevation or depression.

note.zh-CN: 基线心电图有助于病因评估，但不应延误溶栓。
note.en: A baseline ECG helps establish the mechanism but must not delay thrombolysis.

text.zh-CN: 血常规正常：白细胞 7.6 × 10⁹/L，血红蛋白 142 g/L，血小板 208 × 10⁹/L。
text.en: Normal full blood count: WBC 7.6 × 10⁹/L, haemoglobin 142 g/L, platelets 208 × 10⁹/L.

note.zh-CN: 无抗凝药使用史、无出血倾向时，不应为等待血小板结果而推迟溶栓（血小板 < 100 × 10⁹/L为禁忌）。
note.en: With no anticoagulant use and no suspicion of a bleeding disorder, thrombolysis should not wait for the platelet count (platelets < 100 × 10⁹/L is a contraindication).

text.zh-CN: 凝血功能正常：PT 12.4 s，INR 1.02，APTT 31.0 s，纤维蛋白原 3.0 g/L。
text.en: Normal coagulation: PT 12.4 s, INR 1.02, APTT 31.0 s, fibrinogen 3.0 g/L.

note.zh-CN: 仅在使用抗凝药或怀疑凝血异常时，溶栓前才需等待凝血结果（INR > 1.7、PT > 15 s或APTT > 40 s为禁忌）。
note.en: Coagulation results need to precede thrombolysis only if anticoagulant use or a coagulopathy is suspected (INR > 1.7, PT > 15 s or APTT > 40 s is a contraindication).

name.zh-CN: 肾功能、电解质及肝功能
name.en: Renal function, electrolytes and liver enzymes

text.zh-CN: Na⁺ 139 mmol/L，K⁺ 4.1 mmol/L，Cl⁻ 103 mmol/L，HCO₃⁻ 24 mmol/L（阴离子间隙 12 mmol/L），尿素 6.2 mmol/L，肌酐 88 µmol/L（1.0 mg/dL），eGFR 83 mL/min/1.73 m²（CKD-EPI 2021），血浆葡萄糖 7.4 mmol/L（非空腹），ALT 24 U/L。
text.en: Na⁺ 139 mmol/L, K⁺ 4.1 mmol/L, Cl⁻ 103 mmol/L, HCO₃⁻ 24 mmol/L (anion gap 12 mmol/L), urea 6.2 mmol/L, creatinine 88 µmol/L (1.0 mg/dL), eGFR 83 mL/min/1.73 m² (CKD-EPI 2021), plasma glucose 7.4 mmol/L (non-fasting), ALT 24 U/L.

text.zh-CN: 高敏肌钙蛋白T 12 ng/L（第99百分位上限 14 ng/L），正常。
text.en: hs-cTnT 12 ng/L (99th-percentile upper reference limit 14 ng/L) — normal.

note.zh-CN: 推荐检测，但不应因此延误溶栓。
note.en: Recommended at baseline, but it must not delay thrombolysis.

text.zh-CN: 总胆固醇 5.4 mmol/L，甘油三酯 1.8 mmol/L，HDL-C 1.1 mmol/L，LDL-C 3.5 mmol/L（Friedewald计算），HbA1c 6.1%（43 mmol/mol）。
text.en: Total cholesterol 5.4 mmol/L, triglycerides 1.8 mmol/L, HDL-C 1.1 mmol/L, LDL-C 3.5 mmol/L (Friedewald), HbA1c 6.1% (43 mmol/mol).

note.zh-CN: 用于二级预防，不属于超急性期决策所需检查。
note.en: Useful for secondary prevention later; not needed for any hyperacute decision.

text.zh-CN: ABO血型A型，RhD阳性；不规则抗体筛查阴性。
text.en: Blood group A, RhD positive; antibody screen negative.

text.zh-CN: 床旁胸片（仰卧位）：心影大小处于正常上限（心胸比约0.52），双肺野清晰，无渗出或胸腔积液；主动脉迂曲，纵隔不宽。
text.en: Portable chest X-ray (supine): heart size at the upper limit of normal (cardiothoracic ratio about 0.52); lungs clear, no consolidation or effusion; unfolded aorta, mediastinum not widened.

note.zh-CN: 无心肺急症线索时，胸片不应延误溶栓。
note.en: Without a cardiopulmonary indication, a chest X-ray must not delay thrombolysis.

text.zh-CN: 未行MRI：本院超急性期卒中通道以CT/CTA为首选影像，MRI需另行转运且至少增加30–45分钟，会延误再灌注治疗。本病例无MRI结果。
text.en: No MRI was performed: this hospital's hyperacute stroke pathway uses CT/CTA first-line; MRI would need a separate transfer and add at least 30–45 minutes, delaying reperfusion. There is no MRI result in this case.

text.zh-CN: 急诊未行超声心动图；病因学评估（心超、动态心电图）安排在卒中单元进行，本病例未记录其结果。
text.en: No echocardiogram in the ED; the aetiological work-up (echo, Holter) is done on the stroke unit and its results are not recorded in this case.

name.zh-CN: 调阅电子病历（既往门诊记录）

text.zh-CN: 心内科门诊（2年前）：动态心电图证实阵发性心房颤动。CHA₂DS₂-VASc 2分（年龄65–74岁1分、高血压1分），建议口服抗凝药（NOAC），患者拒绝，已签字记录。近12个月处方：氨氯地平5 mg每日一次；无抗凝药或抗血小板药处方记录。既往无脑出血、卒中或消化道出血住院记录。外科史：腹股沟疝修补术（15年前）。去年体检：空腹血糖6.4 mmol/L，肌酐86 µmol/L。过敏史：无。
text.en: Cardiology clinic (2 years ago): paroxysmal atrial fibrillation confirmed on Holter. CHA₂DS₂-VASc 2 (age 65–74 = 1, hypertension = 1); oral anticoagulation (a NOAC) recommended — patient declined, documented with his signature. Prescriptions in the last 12 months: amlodipine 5 mg once daily; no anticoagulant or antiplatelet prescriptions on record. No admissions for intracranial haemorrhage, stroke or GI bleeding. Surgical history: inguinal hernia repair (15 years ago). Check-up last year: fasting glucose 6.4 mmol/L, creatinine 86 µmol/L. Allergies: none recorded.

refText.zh-CN: 卒中前评分；现为4分（卒中 +2）

name.zh-CN: 脑血管造影（DSA）与机械取栓

text.zh-CN: 经右股动脉入路，局麻 + 轻度镇静。左侧颈内动脉造影：左侧大脑中动脉M1段近端闭塞仍持续（eTICI 0）。采用支架取栓 + 近端抽吸联合技术，第1次取栓即取出暗红色血栓：左侧大脑中动脉近完全再通，eTICI 2c（仅一支远端M4小分支未显影）。穿刺至再通26分钟。无造影剂外渗，无新发区域栓塞。台上复评NIHSS 6分（右侧面瘫1、右上肢2、右下肢1、语言1、构音障碍1）。
text.en: Right femoral access under local anaesthesia with light sedation. Left ICA run: the proximal left MCA M1 occlusion persists (eTICI 0). Combined stent-retriever plus proximal aspiration; the first pass retrieves a dark-red thrombus with near-complete recanalisation of the left MCA, eTICI 2c (one small distal M4 branch remains unfilled). Puncture-to-reperfusion 26 minutes. No contrast extravasation and no emboli to a new territory. On-table NIHSS 6 (right face 1, right arm 2, right leg 1, language 1, dysarthria 1).

note.zh-CN: 静脉溶栓（如已给予）不因取栓而中断；术后24小时复查影像前不使用抗栓药。
note.en: Intravenous thrombolysis, if given, is not interrupted for the procedure; no antithrombotics until the 24-hour follow-up imaging.

message.zh-CN: 脑血管造影/机械取栓在神经介入导管室进行：联系神经介入团队并将患者转入导管室后才会有结果。
message.en: Cerebral angiography / thrombectomy happens in the neuro-angiography suite: results exist only once the neurointervention team has been called and the patient is there.

message.zh-CN: 提示：MRI不在本院超急性期卒中通道内，需另行转运。
message.en: Note: MRI is not part of this hospital's hyperacute stroke pathway and needs a separate transfer.

name.zh-CN: 持续心电、血压、血氧监护
name.en: Continuous ECG, BP and SpO₂ monitoring

response.zh-CN: 监护仪已连接：持续心电（心房颤动律）、无创血压每5分钟一次及血氧监测。
response.en: Monitor attached: continuous ECG (atrial fibrillation), NIBP every 5 minutes and SpO₂.

dose.zh-CN: 左肘正中静脉18G留置针（满足CTA高压注射），同时抽取血常规、凝血、生化、血型标本；必要时另建第二通路
dose.en: 18G cannula in the left antecubital fossa (suitable for CTA power injection), drawing samples for FBC, coagulation, chemistry and group at the same time; second line if needed

response.zh-CN: 左肘正中18G留置针已置入，血标本已留取并送检（需另行开具检验）。
response.en: 18G cannula sited in the left antecubital fossa; blood samples taken and ready to send (order the tests separately).

name.zh-CN: 启动院内卒中绿色通道（卒中小组）
name.en: Activate the in-hospital stroke code (stroke team)

response.zh-CN: 卒中小组已启动：神经内科值班医生5分钟内到床旁，CT室已预留，药房备好溶栓药。
response.en: Stroke code activated: the on-call neurologist will be at the bedside within 5 minutes, the CT scanner is held and pharmacy has thrombolytics ready.

response.zh-CN: 已给予鼻导管吸氧2 L/min。（提示：SpO₂ ≥ 94%的卒中患者不常规吸氧。）
response.en: Nasal cannula oxygen 2 L/min started. (Note: routine oxygen is not recommended for stroke patients with SpO₂ ≥ 94%.)

dose.zh-CN: 拉贝洛尔 10 mg 静脉注射（1–2分钟），必要时10分钟后可重复一次（10–20 mg）
dose.en: Labetalol 10 mg IV over 1–2 min; may repeat once after 10 min (10–20 mg)

harm.zh-CN: 血压已低于目标或心率偏慢时继续降压，可减少缺血半暗带灌注、加重神经功能缺损。溶栓前目标 < 185/110 mmHg，溶栓后24小时 < 180/105 mmHg，不追求“正常血压”。
harm.en: Lowering further when BP is already below target (or the heart rate is slow) reduces perfusion of the ischaemic penumbra and can worsen the deficit. Target < 185/110 mmHg before lysis and < 180/105 mmHg for 24 h afterwards — not a "normal" BP.

response.zh-CN: 拉贝洛尔10 mg已缓慢静推，约5–7分钟起效；请5分钟后复测血压。
response.en: Labetalol 10 mg given slowly IV; expect an effect over 5–7 minutes — recheck BP in 5 minutes.

dose.zh-CN: 尼卡地平 5 mg/h 静脉泵入起始，每5–15分钟上调2.5 mg/h，最大15 mg/h；达标后调整维持
dose.en: Nicardipine 5 mg/h IV infusion, increase by 2.5 mg/h every 5–15 min to a maximum of 15 mg/h; adjust once at target

harm.zh-CN: 血压已低于目标时启动强效扩血管药，可导致半暗带低灌注。溶栓前 < 185/110 mmHg、溶栓后 < 180/105 mmHg即可。
harm.en: Starting a potent vasodilator when BP is already below target risks penumbral hypoperfusion. The aim is < 185/110 mmHg before lysis and < 180/105 mmHg afterwards.

response.zh-CN: 尼卡地平以5 mg/h泵入，按血压逐步上调；起效较拉贝洛尔慢（约10–15分钟）。
response.en: Nicardipine running at 5 mg/h and being up-titrated against BP; slower onset than labetalol (about 10–15 minutes).

dose.zh-CN: 乌拉地尔 12.5 mg 缓慢静注，5分钟后未达标可重复（12.5–25 mg）；需要时静脉泵入维持（常用约9 mg/h），按血压滴定
dose.en: Urapidil 12.5 mg slow IV, repeat after 5 min if not at target (12.5–25 mg); maintenance infusion if needed (typically about 9 mg/h), titrated to BP

harm.zh-CN: 血压已低于目标时继续推注会减少半暗带灌注。溶栓前 < 185/110 mmHg、溶栓后 < 180/105 mmHg即可。
harm.en: Further boluses below target reduce penumbral perfusion. Aim for < 185/110 mmHg before lysis and < 180/105 mmHg afterwards.

response.zh-CN: 乌拉地尔12.5 mg已缓慢静注，约5分钟后复测血压。
response.en: Urapidil 12.5 mg given slowly IV; recheck BP in about 5 minutes.

dose.zh-CN: 硝苯地平 10 mg 舌下含服

harm.zh-CN: 舌下含服短效硝苯地平导致血压不可控地骤降，急性缺血性卒中时会使依赖侧支循环的半暗带低灌注、梗死扩大；而且患者吞咽功能未评估，经口给药有误吸风险。应使用可滴定的静脉药物（拉贝洛尔、尼卡地平、乌拉地尔）平稳降压。
harm.en: Sublingual short-acting nifedipine causes an uncontrollable, precipitous fall in BP; in acute ischaemic stroke this starves the collateral-dependent penumbra and extends the infarct — and his swallow has not been screened, so anything by mouth risks aspiration. Use a titratable IV agent (labetalol, nicardipine, urapidil) for smooth lowering.

response.zh-CN: 硝苯地平10 mg已舌下含服。
response.en: Nifedipine 10 mg given sublingually.

name.zh-CN: 向患者及家属解释溶栓/取栓并取得知情同意

response.zh-CN: 妻子听完解释后表示理解，患者点头同意；妻子在溶栓/取栓知情同意书上签字（谈话约3分钟，未延误治疗）。
response.en: His wife says she understands, the patient nods his agreement, and she signs the thrombolysis/thrombectomy consent (about 3 minutes; treatment not delayed).

dose.zh-CN: 阿替普酶 0.9 mg/kg（最大90 mg），按他的体重计算——其中10%于1分钟内静推，其余于60分钟内静脉泵入
dose.en: Alteplase 0.9 mg/kg (max 90 mg) by his weight — 10% as an IV bolus over 1 minute, the rest infused over 60 minutes

harm.zh-CN: 溶栓前的安全前提未全部满足。必须：①头颅CT排除出血；②血压 < 185/110 mmHg；③已测血糖；④明确未使用抗凝药（或凝血结果正常）；⑤未同时使用另一种溶栓药；⑥取栓已再通后不再静脉溶栓。任何一条不满足都会显著增加症状性颅内出血的风险——即使事后CT未见出血，跳过任何一步也不安全。
harm.en: Thrombolysis was given before every safety prerequisite was met. You need (1) a CT that excludes haemorrhage, (2) BP < 185/110 mmHg, (3) a glucose result, (4) confirmation that no anticoagulant is being taken (or a normal coagulation screen), (5) no second thrombolytic and (6) no reperfusion already achieved by thrombectomy. Missing any of these sharply raises the risk of symptomatic intracranial haemorrhage — even when a CT later shows no bleed, skipping a step is not safe.

response.zh-CN: 阿替普酶7.2 mg已静推，64.8 mg开始60分钟泵入。溶栓开始：神经功能与血压每15分钟评估一次。
response.en: Alteplase 7.2 mg bolus given; 64.8 mg infusion started over 60 minutes. Thrombolysis under way — neuro checks and BP every 15 minutes.

dose.zh-CN: 替奈普酶 0.25 mg/kg（最大25 mg），按他的体重计算，5–10秒内单次静推
dose.en: Tenecteplase 0.25 mg/kg (max 25 mg) by his weight, as a single IV bolus over 5–10 seconds

harm.zh-CN: 溶栓前的安全前提未全部满足。必须：①头颅CT排除出血；②血压 < 185/110 mmHg；③已测血糖；④明确未使用抗凝药（或凝血结果正常）；⑤未同时使用另一种溶栓药；⑥取栓已再通后不再静脉溶栓。任何一条不满足都会显著增加症状性颅内出血的风险——即使事后CT未见出血，跳过任何一步也不安全。
harm.en: Thrombolysis was given before every safety prerequisite was met. You need (1) a CT that excludes haemorrhage, (2) BP < 185/110 mmHg, (3) a glucose result, (4) confirmation that no anticoagulant is being taken (or a normal coagulation screen), (5) no second thrombolytic and (6) no reperfusion already achieved by thrombectomy. Missing any of these sharply raises the risk of symptomatic intracranial haemorrhage — even when a CT later shows no bleed, skipping a step is not safe.

response.zh-CN: 替奈普酶20 mg已单次静推。溶栓开始：神经功能与血压每15分钟评估一次。
response.en: Tenecteplase 20 mg given as a single IV bolus. Thrombolysis under way — neuro checks and BP every 15 minutes.

dose.zh-CN: 阿司匹林 300 mg 口服（吞咽不安全时可经直肠给药）
dose.en: Aspirin 300 mg orally (rectally if the swallow is unsafe)

harm.zh-CN: 溶栓后24小时内（复查影像排除出血前）不应给予抗血小板药：早期联用阿司匹林增加症状性颅内出血而不改善结局（ARTIS试验）。CT排除出血前给药同样不安全；本例为溶栓候选者，阿司匹林不能替代再灌注治疗。
harm.en: No antiplatelet within 24 h of thrombolysis (until follow-up imaging excludes haemorrhage): early aspirin raises symptomatic ICH without improving outcome (ARTIS). Giving it before CT has excluded a bleed is equally unsafe, and in a reperfusion candidate aspirin is no substitute for reperfusion.

response.zh-CN: 阿司匹林300 mg已给予。
response.en: Aspirin 300 mg given.

dose.zh-CN: 普通肝素 5000 U 静推后持续泵入
dose.en: Unfractionated heparin 5,000 U IV bolus then infusion

harm.zh-CN: 房颤相关急性缺血性卒中不推荐早期紧急肝素抗凝：不降低早期复发，却增加梗死后出血转化；溶栓后24小时内更是禁用。长期口服抗凝的启动时机应在复查影像后、依据梗死大小决定。
harm.en: Urgent heparin is not recommended in AF-related acute ischaemic stroke: it does not reduce early recurrence but increases haemorrhagic transformation — and within 24 h of thrombolysis it is contraindicated. When to start long-term oral anticoagulation is decided after follow-up imaging, according to infarct size.

response.zh-CN: 普通肝素已推注并开始泵入。
response.en: Heparin bolus given and infusion started.

dose.zh-CN: 20%甘露醇 125 mL 静脉快速滴注

harm.zh-CN: 超急性期CT无脑水肿、无占位效应，不存在颅内压增高证据，不应常规使用甘露醇；它会导致脱水、电解质紊乱和肾损伤，且延误真正有效的再灌注治疗。
harm.en: In the hyperacute phase there is no oedema, mass effect or evidence of raised intracranial pressure, so mannitol has no role; it causes dehydration, electrolyte disturbance and kidney injury and distracts from the treatment that works — reperfusion.

response.zh-CN: 甘露醇已开始滴注。
response.en: Mannitol infusion started.

name.zh-CN: 经口饮水/口服常规药物
name.en: Give water or his usual oral tablets

harm.zh-CN: 卒中患者在床旁吞咽筛查通过之前必须禁食禁水（包括口服药）。他有右侧面瘫和构音障碍，筛查前应视为吞咽不安全（本例吞咽筛查也确实未通过），经口摄入可导致误吸和吸入性肺炎。
harm.en: A stroke patient must stay nil by mouth — tablets included — until a bedside swallow screen is passed. With right facial weakness and dysarthria his swallow must be presumed unsafe until screened (and here it fails the screen); oral intake risks aspiration and pneumonia.

response.zh-CN: 喂了一小口水后患者剧烈呛咳，声音变“湿”，SpO₂短暂下降后恢复。
response.en: After a sip of water he coughs violently and his voice turns "wet"; SpO₂ dips briefly and recovers.

name.zh-CN: 床旁吞咽筛查（饮水试验），未通过前禁食禁水
name.en: Bedside swallow screen (water-swallow test); nil by mouth until passed

response.zh-CN: 吞咽筛查：先以小勺（每次5 mL）饮水，第2勺即出现呛咳、声音湿浊——未通过，未继续进行30 mL洼田饮水试验。维持禁食禁水（含口服药），必要时静脉补液，请言语/吞咽治疗师进一步评估，暂不留置胃管（溶栓后24小时内尽量避免）。
response.en: Swallow screen: 5 mL teaspoons of water first — he coughs and his voice turns wet on the second spoonful: failed, so the 30 mL (Kubota) water-swallow test is not attempted. Keep nil by mouth (tablets included), IV fluids as needed, refer to speech and language therapy; avoid a nasogastric tube for now (best avoided in the first 24 h after lysis).

response.zh-CN: 已下达：神经功能评估与血压监测——前2小时每15分钟、随后6小时每30分钟、之后每小时至24小时；血压维持 < 180/105 mmHg；24小时内不用抗血小板/抗凝药；尽量避免动脉穿刺、导尿和胃管；出现头痛、呕吐、意识或肌力恶化立即停止仍在输注的溶栓药（阿替普酶）并急查CT；24小时复查头颅影像。
response.en: Ordered: neuro checks and BP every 15 min for 2 h, every 30 min for the next 6 h, then hourly to 24 h; keep BP < 180/105 mmHg; no antiplatelets or anticoagulants for 24 h; avoid arterial punctures, urinary catheters and NG tubes where possible; for headache, vomiting or any neurological worsening stop any thrombolytic infusion still running (alteplase) and get an urgent CT; repeat brain imaging at 24 h.

name.zh-CN: 联系神经介入团队（启动取栓）

response.zh-CN: 已通知神经介入值班医生：团队在院内，导管室约15分钟后可准备就绪，CTA证实大血管闭塞后即可接收。如符合静脉溶栓条件，不必为等介入团队而延误溶栓（阿替普酶输注中则不中断）；带监护转运，并在交接中说明用药与时间。
response.en: The on-call neurointerventionist is alerted: the team is in-house and the suite can be ready in about 15 minutes, to take him once CTA confirms a large-vessel occlusion. If he is eligible for IV thrombolysis, don't delay it waiting for the team (and don't stop an alteplase infusion that is running); transfer on the monitor and hand over drugs and times.

name.zh-CN: 转入神经介入导管室行机械取栓
name.en: Transfer to the neuro-angiography suite for thrombectomy

harm.zh-CN: 在头颅CT排除出血、CTA证实大血管闭塞之前（或疑似症状性颅内出血时）不应送去取栓：血管内治疗的前提是影像证实可取栓的闭塞且无颅内出血。
harm.en: He should not go for thrombectomy before CT has excluded haemorrhage and CTA has shown a treatable large-vessel occlusion — or while a symptomatic haemorrhage is suspected: endovascular treatment depends on imaging that proves both.

response.zh-CN: 已安排转运：床旁血糖、NIHSS、头颅CT平扫与CTA均已判读后，患者即在监护下由医生、护士陪同转入神经介入导管室；疑似颅内出血时介入团队不接收。
response.en: Transfer arranged: once the bedside glucose, NIHSS, plain CT and CTA have all been read, he goes on the monitor, escorted by a doctor and nurse, to the neuro-angiography suite. The angio team will not take him while a haemorrhage is suspected.

name.zh-CN: 疑似症状性颅内出血处理（停溶栓、急查CT、纠正纤溶）
name.en: Suspected symptomatic ICH protocol (stop lysis, urgent CT, reverse fibrinolysis)

harm.zh-CN: 没有出血征象时停止溶栓或给予抗纤溶药，会让患者失去再灌注获益。
harm.en: Stopping thrombolysis or giving antifibrinolytics without signs of bleeding throws away the benefit of reperfusion.

response.zh-CN: 如溶栓药仍在输注，立即停止；急查头颅CT、血常规、凝血及纤维蛋白原，配血；给予冷沉淀10 U（纤维蛋白原 < 1.5 g/L时追加）和/或氨甲环酸1 g静滴10分钟；控制血压；请血液科和神经外科急会诊。
response.en: Any thrombolytic infusion still running is stopped at once; urgent CT head, FBC, coagulation and fibrinogen, crossmatch; cryoprecipitate 10 U (more if fibrinogen < 1.5 g/L) and/or tranexamic acid 1 g IV over 10 minutes; BP control; urgent haematology and neurosurgical review.

message.zh-CN: 护士：“医生，他还没测过血糖，要不要我先扎个指尖血糖？”
message.en: Nurse: "Doctor, nobody has checked his sugar yet — shall I do a fingerstick glucose?"

message.zh-CN: 护士：“CT室一直给我们留着呢，病人到院已经20分钟了，还没开头颅CT平扫。”
message.en: Nurse: "CT is still holding the scanner for us — he's been here 20 minutes and there's no plain CT head ordered yet."

message.zh-CN: 护士：“医生，病人到院已经整整1小时了，溶栓还没开始。”
message.en: Nurse: "Doctor, he's been here a full hour and thrombolysis hasn't started."

message.zh-CN: 护士：“医生！他突然抱着头喊疼，刚吐了一次，现在叫不太醒了！血压又冲上去了！”（溶栓时血压仍高于185/110 mmHg——疑似症状性颅内出血）
message.en: Nurse: "Doctor! He suddenly grabbed his head in pain, he's just vomited and now he's hard to rouse! His pressure has shot up again!" (Thrombolysis was given with BP still above 185/110 mmHg — suspected symptomatic intracranial haemorrhage.)

message.zh-CN: 护士：“医生，溶栓前核查还没完成——CT排除出血、血糖、抗凝药，这几项还没全部确认！”
message.en: Nurse: "Doctor, the pre-lysis checklist isn't complete — CT excluding a bleed, glucose and anticoagulant status haven't all been confirmed!"

message.zh-CN: 护士：“含了硝苯地平以后血压一下掉下来了，他比刚才嗜睡，右胳膊现在完全不动了！”
message.en: Nurse: "His pressure has dropped like a stone since the nifedipine — he's drowsier than before and his right arm isn't moving at all now!"

message.zh-CN: 护士：“医生，他比刚来时差多了——眼睛一直往左边偏，叫他半天才睁眼，右边手脚完全不动了。”（未再灌注，梗死进展）
message.en: Nurse: "Doctor, he's much worse than when he came in — his eyes are fixed to the left, he barely opens them to his name, and his right side isn't moving at all." (No reperfusion — the infarct is growing.)

message.zh-CN: 导管室：第1次取栓后左侧大脑中动脉再通（eTICI 2c）。患者能说出简短的词句，右手可以稍微抬起来了。
message.en: Angio suite: left MCA recanalised after the first pass (eTICI 2c). He is getting short phrases out and can lift his right hand a little.

message.zh-CN: 护士：“医生，用了这么多降压药，他血压掉得太多了——人更迷糊了，右边完全不动了！”（再灌注前血压降得过低：依赖侧支供血的缺血半暗带灌注不足。）
message.en: Nurse: "Doctor, after all those antihypertensives his pressure has dropped a long way — he's drowsier and his right side has stopped moving altogether!" (BP over-lowered before reperfusion: the collateral-dependent penumbra is losing perfusion.)

hint.zh-CN: 先问清“最后正常时间”（不是被发现的时间），床旁测血糖排除低血糖，同时接监护、开放静脉并抽血——这些要在几分钟内并行完成。
hint.en: Pin down the last-known-well time (not the time he was found), check a bedside glucose to exclude hypoglycaemia, and in parallel get him on the monitor with IV access and bloods — all within minutes.

guidance.zh-CN: 到抢救床旁：向妻子问清时间线，测指尖血糖，接监护，开放静脉。
guidance.en: At the resus bay: get the timeline from his wife, check a fingerstick glucose, attach the monitor and get IV access.

title.zh-CN: 神经系统评估与急诊影像

hint.zh-CN: 完成NIHSS并定位病灶。首选影像只有两个任务：尽快排除出血、找到可取栓的大血管闭塞。到院20分钟内应完成影像检查。
hint.en: Score the NIHSS and localise the lesion. The first imaging has two jobs: exclude haemorrhage and find a treatable large-vessel occlusion — fast. Imaging should be done within 20 minutes of arrival.

guidance.zh-CN: 做NIHSS，到会诊板选择首选影像，开单并判读CT，然后给出定位与病因判断。
guidance.en: Do the NIHSS, choose the first imaging at the board, order and read the CT, then commit to a localisation and mechanism.

title.zh-CN: 静脉溶栓适应证与禁忌证

hint.zh-CN: 溶栓前要核实：抗凝/抗血小板药、出血史、近期手术或外伤。房颤患者尤其要明确问“有没有吃抗凝药”——确认没有，就不必等凝血和血小板结果。
hint.en: Before lysis confirm anticoagulant/antiplatelet use, bleeding history and recent surgery or trauma. In a patient with AF ask explicitly about anticoagulants — once you know there are none, you need not wait for coagulation or platelet results.

guidance.zh-CN: 针对性询问禁忌证，然后在会诊板上做出溶栓决定。
guidance.en: Ask targeted contraindication questions, then make the thrombolysis decision at the board.

hint.zh-CN: 溶栓前血压必须 < 185/110 mmHg：用可滴定的静脉降压药（拉贝洛尔、尼卡地平或乌拉地尔），不要舌下含服硝苯地平。按他的体重计算剂量（先问清体重）。入院至溶栓时间（DNT）目标 ≤ 60分钟。
hint.en: BP must be < 185/110 mmHg before lysis: use a titratable IV agent (labetalol, nicardipine or urapidil), never sublingual nifedipine. Dose by his weight (ask for it first). Door-to-needle target ≤ 60 minutes.

guidance.zh-CN: 降压达标后给予阿替普酶或替奈普酶。
guidance.en: Once BP is below the threshold, give alteplase or tenecteplase.

title.zh-CN: 确定性治疗与后续管理

hint.zh-CN: 如果CTA证实前循环大血管闭塞，溶栓后应立即桥接取栓，不要等着看溶栓效果。溶栓后24小时内血压 < 180/105 mmHg、不用抗栓药；任何经口摄入前先做吞咽筛查。
hint.en: If the CTA shows an anterior-circulation LVO, go straight on to thrombectomy after lysis — don't wait to see whether lysis works. After lysis keep BP < 180/105 mmHg and avoid antithrombotics for 24 h; screen swallowing before anything by mouth.

guidance.zh-CN: 判读CTA，在会诊板判断是否符合取栓指征，符合则联系神经介入并转运；下达溶栓后监护医嘱并做吞咽筛查。
guidance.en: Read the CTA and decide at the board whether he meets thrombectomy criteria — if he does, call neurointervention and transfer. Order post-lysis monitoring and a swallow screen.

prompt.zh-CN: 距最后正常时间70分钟，NIHSS 14分。首先应做什么影像检查？
prompt.en: He arrived 70 minutes after last known well with an NIHSS of 14. What imaging comes first?

need.zh-CN: 先问清最后正常时间并完成NIHSS评分。
need.en: Establish the last-known-well time and complete the NIHSS first.

text.zh-CN: 立即头颅CT平扫，并在同一次检查中完成头颈CTA（不等肌酐结果）
text.en: Non-contrast CT head now, with CTA of the head and neck in the same sitting (without waiting for creatinine)

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。CT平扫用于排除出血（溶栓前唯一必需的影像）；NIHSS ≥ 6且有皮层征的患者高度怀疑大血管闭塞，应同时做CTA以筛选取栓。无肾病史者不必等肌酐。溶栓可在CT平扫排除出血后立即开始，不必等CTA结果。
feedback.en: Correct. The plain CT excludes haemorrhage — the only imaging needed before lysis; with an NIHSS ≥ 6 and cortical signs a large-vessel occlusion is likely, so add CTA in the same session to select him for thrombectomy. Without known renal disease, do not wait for creatinine. Lysis can start as soon as the plain CT excludes a bleed — it need not wait for the CTA.

text.zh-CN: 先急查肾功能，确认肌酐正常后再做CT和CTA
text.en: Send renal function first and do CT/CTA once the creatinine is back

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。无已知肾病时，为等肌酐（约40分钟）而推迟CTA只会延误再灌注；对比剂肾病风险远小于延误取栓的危害。
feedback.en: No. Without known renal disease, waiting about 40 minutes for creatinine only delays reperfusion; the contrast-nephropathy risk is far smaller than the harm of delaying thrombectomy.

text.zh-CN: 首选头颅MRI（DWI）以确认梗死
text.en: MRI brain (DWI) first to confirm the infarct

feedback.zh-CN: 不推荐作为本院首选。DWI确实更敏感，但溶栓决策只需要排除出血；MRI需要转运、时间更长，会延误治疗。
feedback.en: Not here. DWI is more sensitive, but the lysis decision only needs haemorrhage excluded; MRI means a transfer and a longer scan, delaying treatment.

text.zh-CN: CT平扫 + CT灌注，根据错配决定是否溶栓
text.en: Plain CT plus CT perfusion, and decide on lysis from the mismatch

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。距最后正常时间 < 4.5小时的溶栓和 < 6小时的取栓都不需要灌注成像；灌注扫描和后处理只会增加时间。
feedback.en: No. Neither thrombolysis within 4.5 h nor thrombectomy within 6 h of last known well needs perfusion imaging; the extra scan and processing just add time.

text.zh-CN: 先做颈动脉超声和经颅多普勒
text.en: Carotid duplex and transcranial Doppler first

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。超声不能排除颅内出血，也不能可靠评估M1闭塞，属于后续病因学检查。
feedback.en: No. Ultrasound cannot exclude intracranial haemorrhage or reliably assess an M1 occlusion; it belongs to the later aetiological work-up.

text.zh-CN: 症状典型，先溶栓再做CT以节省时间
text.en: The picture is typical — lyse first and scan afterwards to save time

feedback.zh-CN: 危险。临床上无法可靠区分脑出血与脑梗死，溶栓前必须先做CT排除出血。
feedback.en: Dangerous. Haemorrhage cannot be reliably distinguished from infarction clinically; CT must exclude a bleed before any thrombolytic.

prompt.zh-CN: 综合查体、CT和病史，病灶部位和最可能的机制是什么？
prompt.en: Bringing together the examination, CT and history: where is the lesion and what is the most likely mechanism?

need.zh-CN: 先完成NIHSS、判读头颅CT，并了解心律情况（病史或心电图）。
need.en: Complete the NIHSS, read the CT head and establish his heart rhythm (history or ECG) first.

text.zh-CN: 左侧大脑中动脉供血区急性缺血性卒中（皮层受累，提示大血管闭塞），心房颤动所致心源性栓塞可能性大
text.en: Acute ischaemic stroke in the left MCA territory (cortical involvement, suggesting a large-vessel occlusion), most likely cardioembolic from atrial fibrillation

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。右侧偏瘫（上肢重于下肢）+ 右侧中枢性面瘫 + 运动性失语 + 左侧凝视偏好 + 右下象限盲 = 左侧大脑中动脉综合征；失语、凝视和视野缺损是皮层征，提示近端大血管闭塞而非腔隙梗死。CT排除出血并见左侧MCA高密度征；未抗凝的阵发性房颤是最可能的栓子来源。
feedback.en: Correct. Right hemiparesis (arm worse than leg) + right central facial palsy + expressive aphasia + left gaze preference + right inferior quadrantanopia = a left MCA syndrome; aphasia, gaze deviation and a field defect are cortical signs pointing to a proximal large-vessel occlusion rather than a lacune. CT excludes haemorrhage and shows a hyperdense left MCA; un-anticoagulated paroxysmal AF is the most likely embolic source.

text.zh-CN: 左侧基底节区脑出血
text.en: Left basal ganglia intracerebral haemorrhage

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。高血压和突发偏瘫确实需要考虑出血，但CT平扫未见出血。
feedback.en: No. Hypertension and sudden hemiparesis do raise the question, but the plain CT shows no haemorrhage.

text.zh-CN: 左侧内囊腔隙性梗死（小血管病）
text.en: Left internal capsule lacunar infarct (small-vessel disease)

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。腔隙综合征没有皮层征——失语、凝视偏斜和视野缺损都提示皮层受累和大血管病变。
feedback.en: No. Lacunar syndromes lack cortical signs — aphasia, gaze deviation and a field defect all indicate cortical involvement and a large-vessel lesion.

text.zh-CN: 右侧大脑中动脉供血区梗死
text.en: Right MCA territory infarct

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。右侧肢体无力合并失语提示左侧（优势）半球；眼睛偏向左侧也说明病灶在左。
feedback.en: No. Right-sided weakness with aphasia means the left (dominant) hemisphere, and the eyes deviate towards the lesion — to the left.

text.zh-CN: 椎-基底动脉系统（后循环）梗死
text.en: Posterior circulation (vertebrobasilar) infarct

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。无眩晕、共济失调、交叉体征或脑干征象；失语、左侧凝视偏好和面部与上肢为重的偏瘫定位于前循环，CT也见左侧MCA高密度征（单纯视野缺损前、后循环均可引起，不能据此区分）。
feedback.en: No. There is no vertigo, ataxia, crossed signs or brainstem features; aphasia, left gaze preference and a face- and arm-predominant hemiparesis place it in the anterior circulation, and CT shows a hyperdense left MCA (a field defect on its own could come from either territory).

text.zh-CN: 癫痫发作后Todd麻痹
text.en: Todd's paresis after a seizure

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。没有抽搐、咬舌或失禁，也无癫痫史；不能用“可能是发作后”而延误再灌注。
feedback.en: No. There was no shaking, tongue bite or incontinence and no epilepsy history; a speculative post-ictal explanation must not delay reperfusion.

text.zh-CN: 低血糖所致类卒中发作
text.en: Hypoglycaemic stroke mimic

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。指尖血糖7.2 mmol/L，已排除低血糖。
feedback.en: No. The capillary glucose is 7.2 mmol/L — hypoglycaemia is excluded.

prompt.zh-CN: 关于静脉溶栓，哪项处理正确？
prompt.en: Which is the right approach to intravenous thrombolysis?

need.zh-CN: 先判读头颅CT、测血糖，并明确是否在用抗凝药。
need.en: Read the CT head, check the glucose and establish whether he takes anticoagulants first.

text.zh-CN: 符合溶栓：先用静脉药将血压降至 < 185/110 mmHg，随即给予阿替普酶0.9 mg/kg或替奈普酶0.25 mg/kg，不必等血小板和凝血结果，并同时准备取栓
text.en: Eligible: lower BP to < 185/110 mmHg with an IV agent, then give alteplase 0.9 mg/kg or tenecteplase 0.25 mg/kg straight away without waiting for platelets or coagulation, while preparing for thrombectomy

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。最后正常08:55，到院时70分钟，在4.5小时窗内；CT无出血、ASPECTS 9；血糖正常；妻子和病历均证实未用抗凝药，凝血结果不必等待；无出血史及近期手术外伤。血压192/104 mmHg是可纠正的障碍，而不是禁忌。
feedback.en: Correct. Last known well 08:55 — 70 minutes at arrival, well inside 4.5 h; CT shows no haemorrhage and ASPECTS 9; glucose normal; his wife and the record both confirm no anticoagulant, so coagulation results need not be awaited; no bleeding history or recent surgery/trauma. A BP of 192/104 mmHg is a correctable barrier, not a contraindication.

text.zh-CN: 有房颤病史，先等INR、APTT和血小板结果再决定
text.en: He has AF — wait for the INR, APTT and platelet count before deciding

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。溶栓前唯一必须的化验是血糖；只有在使用抗凝药或怀疑凝血异常时才需等待凝血结果。已明确未用抗凝药，等待约40分钟只会让更多脑组织死亡。
feedback.en: No. The only test that must precede lysis is glucose; coagulation results matter only with anticoagulant use or a suspected coagulopathy. He takes none — waiting about 40 minutes just loses brain.

text.zh-CN: 血压192/104 mmHg，属于溶栓禁忌，不应溶栓
text.en: BP 192/104 mmHg is a contraindication — do not lyse

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。> 185/110 mmHg只是在“降压之前”不能溶栓；用静脉药降到阈值以下即可溶栓。只有积极降压后仍无法达标时才放弃。
feedback.en: No. Above 185/110 mmHg you cannot lyse until the BP is lowered; bring it under the threshold with an IV agent and proceed. Only BP that cannot be controlled despite treatment rules lysis out.

text.zh-CN: 已怀疑大血管闭塞，直接取栓即可，不需要静脉溶栓
text.en: A large-vessel occlusion is suspected, so go straight to thrombectomy without IV lysis

feedback.zh-CN: 不推荐。对符合溶栓条件的前循环大血管闭塞患者，即使直接就诊于可取栓的卒中中心，AHA/ASA和ESO-ESMINT指南仍推荐先静脉溶栓再桥接取栓——直接取栓试验的汇总分析未能证明其不劣于桥接治疗；溶栓不应推迟取栓，取栓也不应取代溶栓。
feedback.en: Not recommended. For lysis-eligible patients with an anterior-circulation LVO — even those arriving directly at a thrombectomy-capable centre — AHA/ASA and ESO-ESMINT guidance still recommends IV thrombolysis bridging to thrombectomy, because pooled analyses of the direct-thrombectomy trials did not establish non-inferiority; lysis must not delay EVT, and EVT does not replace lysis.

text.zh-CN: 发病时刻无人目击，起病时间不明，不能溶栓
text.en: Nobody saw the onset, so the onset time is unknown and he cannot be lysed

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。无人目击时以“最后正常时间”作为起病时间：08:55他还在正常说话，到院时仅70分钟，完全在时间窗内。注意不要用被发现的时间（09:10）来计算。
feedback.en: No. With an unwitnessed onset, last known well is the onset time: at 08:55 he was talking normally, so he is only 70 minutes out at arrival and well within the window. Equally, do not count from the time he was found (09:10).

prompt.zh-CN: 哪些依据支持对他行机械取栓？（多选）
prompt.en: Which findings support mechanical thrombectomy for him? (select all that apply)

need.zh-CN: 先完成NIHSS评分，判读头颅CT和CTA，并了解他发病前的生活自理情况。
need.en: Complete the NIHSS, read the CT head and the CTA, and find out how independent he was before this first.

text.zh-CN: CTA证实前循环大血管闭塞（左侧MCA M1段）
text.en: CTA confirms an anterior-circulation large-vessel occlusion (left MCA M1)

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。颈内动脉或M1段闭塞是取栓获益证据最充分的适应证。
feedback.en: Correct. ICA or M1 occlusion is the indication with the strongest evidence of benefit.

text.zh-CN: NIHSS ≥ 6分（14分）
text.en: NIHSS ≥ 6 (here 14)

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。指南标准为NIHSS ≥ 6分。
feedback.en: Correct. The guideline criterion is NIHSS ≥ 6.

text.zh-CN: ASPECTS ≥ 6分（9分）
text.en: ASPECTS ≥ 6 (here 9)

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ASPECTS 9提示早期缺血范围小、可挽救脑组织多。（2022年以来的大核心梗死试验已将取栓获益扩展到部分ASPECTS 3–5分的患者，因此较低的ASPECTS本身并不一定排除取栓。）
feedback.en: Correct. ASPECTS 9 means little established ischaemia and plenty of salvageable brain. (Large-core trials since 2022 have extended benefit to selected patients with ASPECTS 3–5, so a lower score would not by itself exclude thrombectomy.)

text.zh-CN: 可在最后正常时间后6小时内开始穿刺
text.en: Groin puncture can start within 6 hours of last known well

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。最后正常08:55，6小时窗至14:55，时间充裕。
feedback.en: Correct. Last known well 08:55, so the 6-hour window runs to 14:55 — ample time.

text.zh-CN: 发病前改良Rankin量表（mRS）0–1分，生活完全自理
text.en: Pre-stroke modified Rankin Scale 0–1 (fully independent)

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。发病前每天步行1小时、自理生活，mRS 0分。
feedback.en: Correct. He walked for an hour daily and was fully independent — pre-stroke mRS 0.

text.zh-CN: 必须先有CT灌注证实的错配才能取栓
text.en: A CT-perfusion mismatch must be shown before thrombectomy

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。6小时内的前循环大血管闭塞取栓不需要灌注成像；灌注/影像选择主要用于6–24小时的患者。
feedback.en: No. Within 6 hours, anterior-circulation thrombectomy does not need perfusion imaging; perfusion-based selection is for patients at 6–24 hours.

text.zh-CN: 应等溶栓结束后观察1小时，无改善再考虑取栓
text.en: Wait an hour after thrombolysis finishes and only consider thrombectomy if he has not improved

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。不要等待溶栓效果——M1闭塞单靠静脉溶栓的再通率低（本例血栓长约12 mm，更难溶通），应在溶栓同时立即启动取栓。
feedback.en: No. Don't wait for a response — IV lysis alone recanalises only a minority of M1 occlusions, fewer still with a 12 mm clot like his; start thrombectomy in parallel with lysis.

text.zh-CN: 年龄 ≥ 65岁是取栓的相对禁忌
text.en: Age ≥ 65 is a relative contraindication to thrombectomy

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。年龄本身不是禁忌，高龄患者同样从取栓中获益。
feedback.en: No. Age itself is not a contraindication; older patients benefit from thrombectomy too.

text.zh-CN: 问清最后正常时间（08:55）及发病是否有人目击
text.en: Established the last-known-well time (08:55) and whether the onset was witnessed

text.zh-CN: 溶栓前询问抗凝/抗血小板药、出血史、近期手术及头部外伤
text.en: Before lysis, asked about anticoagulants/antiplatelets, bleeding history, recent surgery and head injury

text.zh-CN: 了解发病前功能状态（mRS）和体重（用于剂量计算）
text.en: Established pre-stroke function (mRS) and weight for dosing

text.zh-CN: 完成NIHSS评分
text.en: Performed the NIHSS

text.zh-CN: 溶栓前床旁测血糖
text.en: Checked a bedside glucose before thrombolysis

text.zh-CN: 到院20分钟内开出头颅CT，并完成CT平扫和CTA判读
text.en: Ordered CT within 20 minutes of arrival and read both the plain CT and the CTA

text.zh-CN: 首次即正确定位左侧MCA综合征并识别心源性栓塞机制
text.en: Correctly localised the left MCA syndrome and identified the cardioembolic mechanism at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 溶栓前用可滴定的静脉药物将血压降至 < 185/110 mmHg，未使用舌下硝苯地平，也未降压过度
text.en: Lowered BP to < 185/110 mmHg with a titratable IV agent before lysis, without sublingual nifedipine or over-lowering

text.zh-CN: 入院至溶栓时间（DNT）≤ 60分钟
text.en: Door-to-needle time ≤ 60 minutes

text.zh-CN: 无抗凝药使用史时未等待凝血/血小板结果再溶栓
text.en: Did not wait for coagulation/platelet results before lysis when no anticoagulant was being taken

text.zh-CN: 对大血管闭塞桥接机械取栓（启动神经介入并转运）
text.en: Bridged to thrombectomy for the large-vessel occlusion (called neurointervention and transferred)

text.zh-CN: 溶栓后24小时内未使用阿司匹林或肝素
text.en: Gave no aspirin or heparin within 24 hours of thrombolysis

text.zh-CN: 任何经口摄入前完成吞咽筛查，并保持禁食禁水
text.en: Screened swallowing before any oral intake and kept him nil by mouth

text.zh-CN: 以通俗语言向妻子和患者解释病情及溶栓/取栓的获益与风险，取得同意且未延误治疗
text.en: Explained the diagnosis and the benefits and risks of thrombolysis/thrombectomy in plain language to his wife and to him, and obtained consent without delaying treatment

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明“脑血管被血块堵住，需要尽快用药溶开并把血块取出来”；交代主要获益（恢复独立生活的机会更大）和主要风险（脑出血，约数个百分点）；不使用术语、确认理解；回应妻子对“像公公一样瘫痪”的恐惧；虽然患者失语，也直接对他说话，用是/否问题确认他的意愿；整个谈话简短（数分钟内），不因签字拖延溶栓。
judgeGuidance.en: Says in plain words that a clot is blocking a brain artery and that a drug to dissolve it and a procedure to pull it out are needed now; gives the main benefit (a better chance of getting back to independent life) and the main risk (bleeding into the brain, a few per cent); avoids jargon and checks understanding; acknowledges the wife's fear of him ending up bedridden like his father; despite the aphasia speaks to him directly and confirms his wishes with yes/no questions; keeps it to a few minutes so consent does not delay lysis.

text.zh-CN: 向神经介入团队进行结构化（SBAR）交接并闭环确认
text.en: Gave a structured (SBAR) handover to the neurointervention team with closed-loop confirmation

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 交接包含：最后正常时间08:55、到院10:05；NIHSS 14分及主要体征；CT无出血、ASPECTS 9；CTA左侧M1闭塞；溶栓药名称、剂量和开始时间；所用降压药及当前血压；血糖7.2 mmol/L；体重80 kg；无抗凝药、无过敏；吞咽筛查未通过、禁食；家属已同意。关键用药医嘱复述确认。
judgeGuidance.en: Covers last known well 08:55 and arrival 10:05; NIHSS 14 and the key signs; CT without haemorrhage, ASPECTS 9; CTA left M1 occlusion; the thrombolytic's name, dose and start time; the antihypertensive used and current BP; glucose 7.2 mmol/L; weight 80 kg; no anticoagulants, no allergies; failed swallow screen and nil by mouth; consent from the family. Key drug orders read back.

name.zh-CN: 林护士（急诊卒中专科护士，化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 交班：67岁男性，10:05由120送入抢救室1床，妻子陪同。分诊生命体征：BP 192/104 mmHg、HR 96次/分不齐、RR 18次/分、SpO₂ 96%（未吸氧）、T 36.8 ℃。院前血糖仪故障未测血糖，未建静脉通路，未用药。体重未称量（妻子知道）。物流：床旁有监护仪、壁式氧气、吸引器、输液泵和指尖血糖仪；CT室在走廊尽头约30米，已因120预警预留；神经介入导管室在二楼，团队工作日白天在院内。急诊备药：阿替普酶、替奈普酶、拉贝洛尔、尼卡地平、乌拉地尔、硝苯地平片、阿司匹林、普通肝素、甘露醇、生理盐水、冷沉淀与氨甲环酸（需血库）。可协助：测血糖、抽血、给药、复测血压、吞咽筛查、转运。不解读影像，不做诊断。
knowledge.en: Handover: 67-year-old man brought by 120 ambulance at 10:05 to resus bay 1 with his wife. Triage vitals: BP 192/104 mmHg, HR 96/min irregular, RR 18/min, SpO₂ 96% on air, T 36.8 °C. No pre-hospital glucose (glucometer failed), no IV access, no medicines. Not weighed (his wife knows his weight). Logistics: the bay has a monitor, wall oxygen, suction, infusion pumps and a glucometer; the CT scanner is about 30 m down the corridor and has been held since the ambulance pre-alert; the neuro-angiography suite is on the second floor and the team is in-house on weekday days. ED stock: alteplase, tenecteplase, labetalol, nicardipine, urapidil, nifedipine tablets, aspirin, unfractionated heparin, mannitol, saline, plus cryoprecipitate and tranexamic acid via the blood bank. Can help with glucose checks, bloods, drugs, repeat BP, the swallow screen and transfer. Does not interpret imaging or offer diagnoses.

knowledge.zh-CN: 院前交接：09:12接警，09:28到达现场。妻子称约09:10发现患者歪在沙发上、右侧手脚无力、说不出话（交接时未提及最后正常时间，需要问妻子）。现场：FAST阳性（右侧面瘫、右上肢无力、言语障碍），BP 196/106 mmHg，HR约100次/分不齐，SpO₂ 95%（空气），GCS评估受失语影响。血糖仪报错未测得血糖；穿刺一次未成功，未建立静脉通路；未给任何药物，未给氧。09:50途中电话预警，10:05到院。途中症状无变化，无抽搐、无呕吐。
knowledge.en: Pre-hospital handover: call received 09:12, on scene 09:28. His wife says she found him at about 09:10 slumped on the sofa with right-sided weakness and unable to talk (the crew did not record a last-known-well time — ask his wife). On scene: FAST positive (right facial droop, right arm weakness, speech disturbance), BP 196/106 mmHg, HR about 100/min irregular, SpO₂ 95% on air, GCS limited by the speech problem. The glucometer gave an error so no glucose was obtained; one failed cannulation attempt, so no IV; no drugs and no oxygen given. Pre-alert phoned at 09:50, arrived 10:05. No change en route, no seizure, no vomiting.

knowledge.zh-CN: 只解读学员已经看过的影像报告，以报告原文为准，不补充报告以外的发现或数字；职责范围：头颅CT平扫、头颈CTA、CT灌注、胸片。可解释ASPECTS的计分方法（从10分起，每个受累区域减1分）和CTA侧支评分的含义；会提醒：溶栓不必等CTA报告，无已知肾病时CTA也不必等肌酐结果。不给出最终诊断或治疗决定。
knowledge.en: Interprets only reports the learner has already reviewed, sticking to the report wording and adding no findings or numbers beyond it; remit: plain CT head, CTA head and neck, CT perfusion, chest X-ray. Can explain how ASPECTS is scored (start at 10, subtract 1 per affected region) and what the CTA collateral grade means; will point out that lysis need not wait for the CTA report and, without known renal disease, CTA need not wait for the creatinine. Does not give the final diagnosis or a treatment decision.

name.zh-CN: 周医生（神经介入值班，化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 接受取栓会诊：团队在院内，导管室约15分钟可接收。只解读学员已看过的CTA、CT灌注和造影结果。要求：溶栓（如已开始）继续，不要等溶栓效果；转运时带监护；术前血压 ≤ 185/110 mmHg，再通后 < 180/105 mmHg，避免过度降压；交接时说明最后正常时间、NIHSS、影像、溶栓药物剂量与时间及体重。说明取栓适应证：前循环大血管闭塞、NIHSS ≥ 6、ASPECTS ≥ 6、6小时内可穿刺、发病前mRS 0–1。
knowledge.en: Accepts thrombectomy referrals: the team is in-house and the suite can take him in about 15 minutes. Interprets only CTA, CT perfusion and angiography results the learner has already seen. Asks that thrombolysis (if started) continue without waiting for a response, that he travel on the monitor, that BP be ≤ 185/110 mmHg before the procedure and < 180/105 mmHg after recanalisation without over-lowering, and that the handover include last known well, NIHSS, imaging, the thrombolytic's dose and time, and weight. Can state the thrombectomy criteria: anterior-circulation LVO, NIHSS ≥ 6, ASPECTS ≥ 6, puncture within 6 h, pre-stroke mRS 0–1.

name.zh-CN: 许医生（卒中中心主治医师，化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，不直接给答案，只讨论学员已获得的信息。引导问题（每个都等学员已掌握相关信息后才提出）：起病时间应从什么时候算——最后正常还是被发现？做溶栓决策前哪些检查是“必须”的、哪些可以并行？病史提示房颤后：为什么一定要问抗凝药？血压超过185/110 mmHg时该怎么办、哪些降压方式是危险的？失语患者如何做NIHSS第1b项？判读CTA之后：它改变了什么？若有取栓指征，取栓不能等什么？选定溶栓后：阿替普酶与替奈普酶按80 kg的剂量有何不同？溶栓后24小时要注意什么？病例结束时：长期抗凝的启动时机为何要在复查影像后决定？
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor: never gives answers outright and discusses only information the learner already has. Guiding questions, each asked only once the learner has the relevant information: from when does the clock start — last known well or when he was found? Which tests must precede a thrombolysis decision and which can run in parallel? Once the history shows AF: why must you ask about anticoagulants? What do you do when BP exceeds 185/110 mmHg, and which ways of lowering it are dangerous? How do you score NIHSS item 1b in an aphasic patient? After the CTA has been read: what does it change, and, if thrombectomy is indicated, what must it not wait for? Once lysis has been chosen: how do the alteplase and tenecteplase doses differ for 80 kg, and what are the rules for the 24 hours afterwards? At the end: why is the timing of long-term anticoagulation decided only after follow-up imaging?

knowledge.zh-CN: 在学员问到体重后按体重核对剂量（他未称重，体重由妻子提供——学员若未问，提醒其先问）：阿替普酶0.9 mg/kg（最大90 mg），其中10%于1分钟内静推，其余于60分钟内泵入；替奈普酶0.25 mg/kg（最大25 mg），单次静推5–10秒。（部分替奈普酶说明书采用体重分档给药表；本院按0.25 mg/kg精确计算，遵循本院方案。）两者只能选一种，不能叠加。降压：拉贝洛尔10–20 mg静注1–2分钟，可重复一次；尼卡地平5 mg/h起，每5–15分钟加2.5 mg/h，最大15 mg/h；乌拉地尔12.5–25 mg缓慢静注，可重复，维持约9 mg/h。提醒：禁用舌下短效硝苯地平；溶栓后24小时内不用抗血小板/抗凝药；甘露醇无指征。不讨论诊断。
knowledge.en: Checks doses by weight once the learner has it (he has not been weighed; his wife knows his weight — if the learner has not asked, prompt them to): alteplase 0.9 mg/kg (max 90 mg) — 10% IV bolus over 1 minute, the rest infused over 60 minutes; tenecteplase 0.25 mg/kg (max 25 mg) as a single bolus over 5–10 seconds. (Some tenecteplase labels use weight-band charts; this hospital's protocol calculates 0.25 mg/kg exactly.) Only one of the two, never both. BP: labetalol 10–20 mg IV over 1–2 min, may repeat once; nicardipine 5 mg/h, up by 2.5 mg/h every 5–15 min, max 15 mg/h; urapidil 12.5–25 mg slow IV, may repeat, maintenance about 9 mg/h. Warns: no sublingual short-acting nifedipine; no antiplatelets or anticoagulants within 24 h of lysis; mannitol has no indication. Does not discuss the diagnosis.

title.zh-CN: 左侧大脑中动脉M1段闭塞所致急性缺血性卒中（心源性栓塞，心房颤动）
title.en: Acute ischaemic stroke from left MCA M1 occlusion (cardioembolic, atrial fibrillation)

conclusion.zh-CN: 67岁男性，高血压、未抗凝的阵发性心房颤动，最后正常时间08:55，09:10被发现右侧偏瘫、运动性失语，10:05到院（距最后正常70分钟）。NIHSS 14分（右侧面瘫、右上肢重于下肢的偏瘫、严重运动性失语、左侧凝视偏好、右下象限盲、右侧感觉减退）。血糖7.2 mmol/L；CT平扫无出血、左侧MCA高密度征、ASPECTS 9分；CTA示左侧MCA M1段近端闭塞，侧支中等偏好；心电图心房颤动。诊断：左侧大脑中动脉供血区急性缺血性卒中，大血管闭塞，心源性栓塞。正确处理：并行完成血糖、监护、静脉通路和抽血；20分钟内完成CT/CTA；明确未用抗凝药后不等凝血和血小板结果；用静脉拉贝洛尔/尼卡地平/乌拉地尔将血压降至 < 185/110 mmHg后，60分钟内给予阿替普酶0.9 mg/kg（72 mg）或替奈普酶0.25 mg/kg（20 mg）；立即桥接机械取栓；溶栓后24小时血压 < 180/105 mmHg、不用抗栓药；经口摄入前做吞咽筛查。取栓1次即达eTICI 2c再通，台上NIHSS降至6分。
conclusion.en: A 67-year-old man with hypertension and un-anticoagulated paroxysmal AF was last known well at 08:55, found at 09:10 with right hemiparesis and expressive aphasia, and arrived at 10:05 (70 minutes after last known well). NIHSS 14 (right facial palsy, right hemiparesis worse in the arm, severe expressive aphasia, left gaze preference, right inferior quadrantanopia, right sensory loss). Glucose 7.2 mmol/L; plain CT without haemorrhage, a hyperdense left MCA and ASPECTS 9; CTA showed a proximal left MCA M1 occlusion with moderate-to-good collaterals; ECG atrial fibrillation. Diagnosis: acute ischaemic stroke in the left MCA territory from a large-vessel occlusion, cardioembolic. Correct management: glucose, monitoring, IV access and bloods in parallel; CT/CTA within 20 minutes; once anticoagulant use was excluded, no waiting for coagulation or platelets; BP brought below 185/110 mmHg with IV labetalol, nicardipine or urapidil, then alteplase 0.9 mg/kg (72 mg) or tenecteplase 0.25 mg/kg (20 mg) within 60 minutes of arrival; immediate bridging to mechanical thrombectomy; for 24 hours after lysis BP < 180/105 mmHg and no antithrombotics; swallow screen before anything by mouth. One thrombectomy pass achieved eTICI 2c recanalisation and the on-table NIHSS fell to 6.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 时间从“最后正常”算起：08:55他还在正常说话，09:10只是被发现的时间。到院时70分钟，溶栓窗口（4.5小时）至13:25，取栓窗口（6小时）至14:55。
keyReasoning.en: The clock starts at last known well: he was talking normally at 08:55 — 09:10 is merely when he was found. He arrived at 70 minutes; the lysis window (4.5 h) runs to 13:25 and the thrombectomy window (6 h) to 14:55.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 运动性失语、凝视偏好和视野缺损是皮层征，加上致密偏瘫和NIHSS 14分，强烈提示左侧前循环大血管闭塞；房颤提示心源性栓塞。腔隙梗死不会有皮层征。
keyReasoning.en: Expressive aphasia, gaze preference and a field defect are cortical signs; with a dense hemiparesis and NIHSS 14 they strongly suggest a left anterior-circulation large-vessel occlusion, and the AF points to cardioembolism. Lacunar strokes do not produce cortical signs.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 溶栓前唯一必须的化验是血糖。凝血与血小板只在使用抗凝药或怀疑凝血异常时才需等待——房颤患者必须明确问抗凝药，本例妻子和病历均确认未用。
keyReasoning.en: The only test that must precede lysis is glucose. Coagulation and platelets need awaiting only with anticoagulant use or a suspected coagulopathy — so in AF you must ask explicitly; here both his wife and the record confirm no anticoagulant.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 血压192/104 mmHg是可纠正的障碍：用可滴定的静脉药降到 < 185/110 mmHg再溶栓，溶栓后24小时 < 180/105 mmHg；舌下硝苯地平之类的骤降会让依赖侧支的半暗带缺血。
keyReasoning.en: A BP of 192/104 mmHg is a correctable barrier: lower it below 185/110 mmHg with a titratable IV agent, then lyse, and keep it < 180/105 mmHg for 24 h. Precipitous drops such as sublingual nifedipine starve the collateral-dependent penumbra.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 前循环大血管闭塞 + NIHSS ≥ 6 + ASPECTS ≥ 6 + 6小时内 + 发病前mRS 0–1 = 取栓指征；溶栓与取栓是桥接关系，不等溶栓效果，6小时内也不需要灌注成像。
keyReasoning.en: Anterior-circulation LVO + NIHSS ≥ 6 + ASPECTS ≥ 6 + within 6 h + pre-stroke mRS 0–1 = thrombectomy; lysis bridges to EVT — don't wait for a response, and within 6 h perfusion imaging is unnecessary.

boundaries.zh-CN: 本病例止于取栓再通及台上NIHSS复评。24小时复查影像、卒中单元管理、出血转化监测、病因学检查（心超、动态心电图）、二级预防（房颤口服抗凝的启动时机、降脂）与康复均不在本病例范围内。溶栓时血压未控制所触发的颅内出血分支为教学演示，时间进程经过压缩：一旦疑似颅内出血，介入团队不再接收取栓，完成出血处理和吞咽筛查后病例结束；若未静脉溶栓而直接取栓，再通后病例结束，评分中与溶栓相关的条目不得分。
boundaries.en: The case ends with thrombectomy recanalisation and the on-table NIHSS. Follow-up imaging at 24 h, stroke-unit care, surveillance for haemorrhagic transformation, the aetiological work-up (echo, Holter), secondary prevention (timing of oral anticoagulation for AF, lipid lowering) and rehabilitation are outside its scope. The haemorrhage branch triggered by lysing with uncontrolled BP is a teaching device with a compressed timeline: once a haemorrhage is suspected the angio team does not take him, and the case closes after the haemorrhage protocol and a swallow screen. If thrombectomy is done without IV lysis, the case closes after reperfusion and the lysis items of the rubric are not met.

unknowns.zh-CN: 发病的确切时刻无人目击，只知道在08:55至09:10之间。
unknowns.en: Nobody witnessed the exact moment of onset — only that it was between 08:55 and 09:10.

unknowns.zh-CN: 当天早晨在家的血压未测量。
unknowns.en: His blood pressure at home that morning was not measured.

unknowns.zh-CN: 父亲卒中的类型（梗死还是出血）不详。
unknowns.en: Whether his father's stroke was ischaemic or haemorrhagic is unknown.

unknowns.zh-CN: 3周前右手麻木发作未就诊，没有任何检查记录。
unknowns.en: The right-hand numbness three weeks earlier was never assessed and has no investigation record.

unknowns.zh-CN: 24小时复查影像、住院经过及90天功能结局（mRS）未记录。
unknowns.en: The 24-hour follow-up imaging, hospital course and 90-day functional outcome (mRS) are not recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 并行处理：到院后数分钟内同时完成血糖、监护、静脉通路与抽血、NIHSS和CT预约；目标为到院至影像 ≤ 20分钟、入院至溶栓（DNT）≤ 60分钟（先进中心 ≤ 45分钟）。
teachingPoints.en: Parallel processing: glucose, monitor, IV access and bloods, NIHSS and the CT booking all within minutes of arrival; targets are door-to-imaging ≤ 20 min and door-to-needle ≤ 60 min (≤ 45 min in high-performing centres).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 剂量（80 kg）：阿替普酶0.9 mg/kg，最大90 mg = 72 mg（10%即7.2 mg于1分钟内静推，余64.8 mg于60分钟泵入）；替奈普酶0.25 mg/kg，最大25 mg = 20 mg单次静推。AHA/ASA 2026指南将两者并列推荐；大血管闭塞拟取栓者，ESO（2023）建议优先选替奈普酶。
teachingPoints.en: Doses (80 kg): alteplase 0.9 mg/kg, max 90 mg = 72 mg (10% — 7.2 mg — bolus over 1 minute, the remaining 64.8 mg over 60 minutes); tenecteplase 0.25 mg/kg, max 25 mg = 20 mg single bolus. The AHA/ASA 2026 guideline recommends either agent; for LVO patients heading to thrombectomy, ESO (2023) suggests tenecteplase over alteplase.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 溶栓后24小时内（复查影像前）不用抗血小板药和抗凝药；血压 < 180/105 mmHg；出现头痛、呕吐、意识或神经功能恶化立即停止仍在输注的阿替普酶并急查CT。
teachingPoints.en: For 24 hours after lysis (until follow-up imaging) give no antiplatelets or anticoagulants and keep BP < 180/105 mmHg; headache, vomiting or any neurological worsening means stopping any alteplase infusion still running and an urgent CT.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 吞咽筛查通过前禁食禁水，包括口服药——卒中后吞咽障碍很常见，误吸性肺炎是可预防的并发症。
teachingPoints.en: Nil by mouth — tablets included — until a swallow screen is passed: dysphagia is common after stroke and aspiration pneumonia is preventable.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 失语会让GCS的言语分偏低，但不代表意识下降；NIHSS第1b项中，因失语而无法回答按错误计分（只有非失语原因不能说话才给1分）。
teachingPoints.en: Aphasia drags the GCS verbal score down without meaning reduced consciousness; on NIHSS item 1b, answers the patient cannot give because of aphasia count as wrong (only inability to speak for non-aphasic reasons scores 1 automatically).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 错失的机会：两年前确诊房颤（CHA₂DS₂-VASc 2分）未抗凝，3周前的短暂右手麻木很可能是TIA。卒中后CHA₂DS₂-VASc升至4分（2024年ESC指南采用的CHA₂DS₂-VA对男性计分相同），长期口服抗凝是二级预防核心，启动时机依据梗死大小在复查影像后决定。
teachingPoints.en: Missed opportunities: AF diagnosed two years ago (CHA₂DS₂-VASc 2) was never anticoagulated, and the transient right-hand numbness three weeks ago was probably a TIA. After the stroke his CHA₂DS₂-VASc is 4 (the 2024 ESC CHA₂DS₂-VA score is identical for a man); long-term oral anticoagulation is the core of secondary prevention, its start timed by infarct size after follow-up imaging.
